people.imagined: Dawn on the Fire Court's terrace. She stands still in the pale-gold robe with her head tilted, listening to something behind the room; the first light touches the robe and it glows faintly, which embarrasses her, and she turns her eyes to the viewer.
people.subject: The moment: at first light on a terrace, she holds her head tilted to one side as if listening to a sound behind the room, then glances at the viewer, a little embarrassed. Face, most important: the head tilted sharply to the right, ear toward the shoulder; a slight, thin young face with quick, bright, market-girl eyes of light amber, a small sharp chin, a small straight nose, a quick half smile, sun-warmed skin. Hair: black, in a high knot with a small red-lacquer pin and one short red feather behind the ear. Body: slight and narrow, standing lightly on her toes. Clothing: a robe of pale gold silk with a crossed collar and long sleeves, glowing faintly where the dawn touches it, closed with a vermilion sash; the hem edged with one narrow gold band. Hands and objects: a plain pale bamboo flute held in both hands before her chest, worn at the finger holes; a folding fan of red feathers tucked in the sash. Background: a blurred terrace of red stone and a pink-gold sky. Light: warm gold dawn from the upper left, bright on the robe. A faint white-gold Light hint around the shoulders, not a glow. Expression: trusting, attentive, a little shy.

people.imagined: Late at night in the Nest, a brush drying in his hand. He has written another letter he will not show anyone, and he glances up as the door opens, covering the page with a fan painted with yellow chrysanthemums.
people.subject: The moment: at a low desk at night, he quickly covers a written page with a fan and looks up at the viewer with a restless, caught look. Face, most important: a fan painted with large yellow chrysanthemums held open over the page, bright against the dark, and ink smudged along both cuffs; a long, lean, angular face, a high forehead, a strong nose, quick dark eyes, a lopsided smile, a faint stubble; a restless energy. A pale ink thumbprint marks his jaw, his eyes are shadowed from a sleepless week, and the lopsided smile is half a laugh at himself. Hair: black, tied in a high knot with a red cord, one long lock falling free. Body: long-limbed, narrow, sitting forward on the edge of the cushion. Clothing: a vermilion silk robe with a crossed collar, sleeves ink-stained at the cuffs; a leather jerkin of a duelist, stitched with a yellow chrysanthemum over the heart, worn over it; a red sash; the hem edged with a gold band. Hands and objects: the open chrysanthemum fan in the right hand; a brush in the left, a drop of ink on the tip. A low lacquered desk holds an inkstone, a stack of blank sheets under a jade weight, and a small tea bowl gone cold. Background: a dark room with a single lamp and a blurred bookshelf. Light: warm lamp light from the upper left. A faint red Fire hint. Expression: brave, restless, secretive.

people.imagined: The vein fort at dusk, a letter half written, a candle by it. She has burned two drafts already; her hand goes to the hairpin her mother wore, and she looks up with a calm that costs her something.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a desk at dusk, she touches her hairpin with one hand and looks up at the viewer calmly, a half-written letter before her. Face, most important: a broad, calm, gentle face, wide-set grey-brown eyes, a firm jaw, a soft full mouth, a face of her father's build and her mother's stillness; a faint line between the brows. Hair: black, in a low coil with an old, worn, red-lacquered wooden hairpin carved with a small flame, polished smooth by years of wear. Body: broad-shouldered, tall, solid, sitting upright. Clothing: a vermilion silk robe, well cut, with a crossed collar and a dark-red sash; the hem edged with two narrow bands, gold and white. Hands and objects: a folded fan of red silk lies on the desk; her left hand rests flat on a sheet of paper; a small candle burns beside it, and two blackened scraps of burned paper lie in a dish. Background: a blurred stone wall with a narrow window and the dusk sky. Beyond the window a strip of the vein's red-brown slope and a patrol on the wall are barely visible, small as pins. Light: a single candle from the lower left, warm gold, with blue dusk behind. Faint red Fire and green Wood hint. Expression: peaceable, steady, grieving.

people.imagined: Before dawn at the outer gate, a row of nervous children kneeling. He has lifted the flute to his lips, bent and smiling, and the first note is about to decide who passes. His stonemason's thumb is on the first hole.
people.subject: The moment: bent forward, he raises a flute to his lips before dawn, smiling, about to blow the first note. Face, most important: a bent, deeply lined, smiling old face, a toothless-looking crinkled smile, cheeks creased like folded cloth, soft white brows and a thin white beard; small, kind, bright dark eyes, half-lidded; hands and spine curved by age. His few teeth are small and yellowed, a white tuft grows in each ear, and a fine blue vein shows at the temple. Hair: thin white, tied in a small knot, with a red cord. Body: bent in the back, shoulders rounded, thick-wristed, small. Clothing: a vermilion robe, faded a little to orange at the elbows but clean and well mended, a crossed collar and a plain dark-red sash; the hem edged with two narrow bands, gold and green. Hands and objects: a bamboo flute worn pale and glossy at the finger holes, held in broad, thick, stonemason's hands with square knuckles. Background: a blurred gate courtyard in blue pre-dawn with a row of small kneeling figures. Rows of small children in plain hemp kneel on the cold stone behind him, their faces pale blobs, and a red lacquered gate stands half open on a courtyard with one lit lantern. Light: faint rose light from the upper left. Faint red Fire and green Wood hint. A thin pink band of dawn on the horizon touches the top of the flute and his white hair. Expression: patient, kind, arbitrary.

people.imagined: Night in the Wutong Court, the aviary hushed. She has just come from the great tree, hands still warm from something she has not told anyone; a blue-backed kingfisher sits on her collar, unmoving.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a dim aviary, she looks quietly toward the viewer with a small blue-backed kingfisher perched on her collar. Face, most important: a vivid blue and white kingfisher the size of a thumb sitting on the collar of her robe at her throat, its beak pointing forward, bright and clear; a quiet, composed, oval face, smooth olive skin, calm hazel eyes, a small mouth, a hint of weariness. Hair: black, in a low knot with a green silk band and a single wutong leaf pin. Body: slender, still, upright. Clothing: a robe of deep leaf-green silk with a crossed collar and a darker green sash, inner layer vermilion showing at the cuffs; the hem edged with two narrow bands, gold and green; a plain wutong-twig ring on the right hand. Hands and objects: a cloth bag of seed in her right hand; a folding fan of green feathers. Background: a blurred aviary of dark wutong boughs with the red-crested heads of sleeping birds. Faint scratches mark the wood of the perches where the birds' talons have gripped, and a basket of fallen green seeds stands on the floor. Light: dim green-gold light from the upper left. Faint green Wood and red Fire hint. Expression: cautious, loyal, quietly concealing.

people.imagined: In an inn courtyard in the north, a letter in his hand, wine on the table. He is reading it aloud with a courteous smile to a companion just out of frame.
people.subject: The moment: seated at an inn table, he holds a letter at arm's length and reads from it with a smooth courteous smile, his eyes lifting to the viewer. Face, most important: a long, courteous, narrow face, high forehead, a pointed beard trimmed fine, a long nose, bright merry black eyes, a polite curve to the mouth that does not reach them; clean, pale hands. A faint smile line cuts each cheek, a small gold earring hangs from his left ear, and the clean-shaven skin of his lip and the trimmed beard are meticulous. Hair: black, neat, oiled, in a high knot with a plain wooden pin. Body: tall, long-limbed, easy, one leg crossed. Clothing: a fine vermilion silk travelling robe with a crossed collar and long sleeves, a short dark-red riding cape over it, a red sash; the hem edged with two narrow bands, gold and white. Hands and objects: an unrolled letter held in the clean right hand; a small cup of wine in the left; a pepper pod on the table. A leather satchel, buckled, lies at his feet. Background: Behind him a pair of wooden shutters stands open on a dark street, a peppercorn pod and a wine jug on the table and, at the far end of it, the blurred shoulder of a second man in a deep blue coat. Light: The lantern light is warm and low and makes the clean fingers of the hand holding the letter glow, from the upper left. Faint red Fire and blue Water hint. Expression: gregarious, courteous and not quite candid.

people.imagined: At night at the black-stone post at the Ash Seat's lip, practising the forbidden fan. She has stopped mid-stroke, caught by a footstep, and her sleeves are no longer perfect.
people.subject: The moment: at night, she holds a feather fan raised and level, mid-stroke, and stares down at the viewer unsmiling. Face, most important: a head of true vivid red hair, the red of flame, long and straight; a tall, narrow, unsmiling face, a sharp straight nose, sharp cheekbones, pale freckled skin, hard amber eyes; at the cuff of her right sleeve a thin dark scorch edge has just begun. A scatter of faint freckles crosses the bridge of her nose and the pale eyelashes are tipped in red-gold, and her mouth is a thin hard line without a trace of warmth. Hair: copper-red, high ponytail tied with a vermilion cord, the loose end whipping. Body: tall, straight, long arms, braced. Clothing: a vermilion silk robe, immaculate, a crossed collar, a dark-red sash; the hem edged with two narrow bands, gold and white; the sleeve edges unburned except the one scorched line. Hands and objects: a red feather fan in the right hand held out; behind her a black-stone post notched with fan marks. Background: a blurred dark vent lip with orange glow far below. A tall post of black volcanic stone stands in front of her, its surface scored with a hundred pale slashes, and behind it a night sky with drifting red sparks rising from the vent far below. Light: orange glow from below and the right, cold dark above. A faint red Fire hint. A deep orange-red glow shines on the underside of her chin and the length of the raised arm, and the stars above are cold and small. Expression: arrogant, ambitious, unyielding.

people.imagined: At the Nest's vent in the evening, her sleeve pushed up. She is turning her scarred arm toward the heat and looks at the viewer with a stubborn jaw, deciding which side she is on.
people.subject: The moment: standing at the glowing lip of a vent at evening, she holds out her bare forearm toward the viewer with her jaw set. Face, most important: skin mottled with old burn marks, areas of shiny pink and white scar tissue across her neck, cheek and arm, plainly visible and rippled; a short, broad, strong face, a flattened nose, thick dark brows, hard dark eyes, a firm square jaw. Her eyebrow on the burnt side is missing and the lid droops a little. Hair: black, cropped very short, uneven. A few grey hairs show among the black at her temple where a burn scar has killed the colour. Body: short, thick-armed, broad, planted. Her stance is square and low, feet wide, as if prepared to be knocked over and refuse to fall. Clothing: a vermilion silk robe with the right sleeve pushed up to the shoulder, crossed collar open at the neck, a dark red sash; the hem edged with one gold band. Hands and objects: her right forearm held out, long and shining with an old burn that runs down to the bone line; a short red fan in the left hand. Background: Behind her a lip of black rock curves round a glowing orange crack in the ground, with a faint red haze above it, and above that a wooden pavilion with a single red lantern. Light: The dusk is violet and the vent's glow lights the burnt arm with a deep orange, from below. A strong red Fire hint. Expression: stubborn, ambitious and wrathful.

people.imagined: In the stable at night, practising the Nest's splice on a spare reel by lamplight, scarf of fire-silk knotted at his neck; caught, he laughs easily to cover it, charming and slightly off.
people.subject: The moment: in a stable at night he holds a reel of silk thread with a half-made splice and smiles with easy charm at the viewer. Face, most important: a fire-silk scarf of an odd, slightly wrong orange, not quite the palace's vermilion, knotted loosely at his throat; a handsome, open, easy face, high cheekbones, a straight nose, a warm wide mouth, soft brown eyes, a bit of stubble. His eyebrows are fine and well shaped, the corner of his mouth lifts in the same lazy smile whatever he does, and a small dimple sits in his chin. Hair: glossy black, tied half up with a silver pin. Body: tall, loose, graceful. He leans against a stall post with one ankle crossed over the other, relaxed, a man who always has time. Clothing: a vermilion silk robe of fine cut with a crossed collar, the sleeves rolled to the forearm, a dark-red sash; the hem edged with a gold band; a travel cloak over one shoulder. Hands and objects: in his hands a small wooden reel wound with orange-red silk thread and a fine needle; a lantern hung on a stall post. Background: blurred horse stalls and hay. The stable behind him has dark wooden stalls, a chestnut horse's head looking over a half-door, a cart loaded with reels of silk wrapped in cloth, and a hay-strewn floor with a small lamp on a hook. Light: warm lantern light from the upper left. Faint red Fire and green Wood hint. Gold lamplight picks out the fine silver pin in his hair and the odd orange of the scarf. Expression: gregarious, trusting and a little guilty.

people.imagined: In the Hall of Rites, rehearsal. A door creaks and he tilts his head toward it, ears first, as if it were a note, flute lowered.
people.subject: The moment: seated in a bare music hall, he tilts his head sharply toward a sound at the side and holds still. Face, most important: the head cocked at a steep angle, one ear lifted toward the sound, eyes distant and unfocused; a long, pale, quiet face, a long nose, thin lips, fine dark brows; slender hands. His ears are slightly large and set a little forward, and the fine lines at his temples crease whenever he listens. Hair: black, in a low tied knot. A loose lock of black hair has come down beside his left ear. Body: slim, seated with straight back. Clothing: a vermilion silk robe, crossed collar, long sleeves, a dark red sash; the hem edged with a gold band. Hands and objects: a long dark bamboo flute held loosely across his knee. Background: a blurred hall with red pillars and a dim zither on a stand. Behind him a row of red-lacquered pillars recede into a dim hall, a low table with a second flute lying across a silk cloth, and a screen painted with a single bird in flight. Light: soft grey light from the upper left. Faint green Wood and red Fire hint. The grey light is even and shadowless, and a thin ray of sun draws a bright line along the flute. Expression: reclusive, patient, intent.

people.imagined: In the Hall of Virtue's copy room, late. He has two stacks, one copy and a second, and looks up with careful blankness at someone entering.
people.subject: The moment: at a desk, he hides a second copy of a letter under a stack, looks up with a careful blank face. Face, most important: ink stains to the second knuckle on both hands, black and glossy, raised on the desk before him; a narrow, pinched, sallow face, a thin hooked nose, small suspicious eyes beneath thin brows, a tight small mouth. Deep vertical creases line his forehead and his thin brows meet in a frown; a small ink spot marks his chin. Hair: grey-black, thin, scraped back in a tiny knot. A few stray grey hairs stand up at the crown. Body: thin, sitting with his shoulders hunched and his elbows in against his sides, covering the desk with his body like a man guarding a hoard. Clothing: a vermilion silk robe with a crossed collar, the sleeves tied back with cord, a dark red sash. Hands and objects: a fine brush in the right hand; two near-identical stacks of paper tied with red cord. Background: a shelf behind him holds scrolls in neat rows, and on the desk before him stand a lamp, a wooden brush stand and an ink stone. Light: a lamp from the upper left; it casts a small bright pool on his hands and leaves his face half in shadow; a faint red Fire hint. Expression: diligent, paranoid, evasive.

people.imagined: At the furnace at Chu Sa Tuyền, tasting a pill her master cannot taste. She wets a fingertip, yellow with turmeric, and lifts it to her tongue and thinks.
people.subject: The moment: standing at an alchemy furnace, she tastes a pinch of powder from a fingertip and considers. Face, most important: fingertips and nails stained bright yellow, cassia and turmeric yellow, held to her lips, a clear saffron yellow against the skin; a round, friendly face, a snub nose, warm brown eyes half closed in concentration, rosy cheeks. A pale line of sweat shines on her upper lip, her eyes are slightly red from steam, and her fingernails are saffron yellow to the quick. Hair: black, in a bun under a cream cloth cap. Body: short and sturdy, a little round. She stands with her weight on one foot and her head cocked, the whole round body concentrated on the taste. Clothing: a vermilion silk robe with the sleeves tied back, a cream apron stained with spice; a dark red sash. Hands and objects: a small pinch of yellow powder on the fingertip; behind her, a squat bronze furnace with orange coals, pots of spices. Background: Behind her squats a bronze furnace the size of a barrel, glowing with orange coals, with shelves of clay pots labelled with a daub of coloured paint, bunches of dried herbs from the beams and a window onto green jungle. Light: A warm orange furnace light plays on her left cheek and the yellow fingertip, from the lower left. Faint red Fire and green Wood hint. Expression: diligent, humble, content.

people.imagined: On a jetty at Thạch Cơ, a knot he has just tied slips. He rubs the old rope scar round his wrist without looking and re-ties it, patient, accepting that nothing he mends stays mended.
people.subject: The moment: on a wooden jetty, he rubs a rope scar on his wrist with his thumb and looks up with calm resignation, a slipped knot in the other hand. Face, most important: a pale rope scar, a ring of raised white skin, circling his left wrist, held up near his chest; a calm, weathered, lean face, a square jaw, a short salt-grey beard, steady dark eyes, wind-chapped lips. Deep wrinkles fan from the corners of his eyes, his lips are cracked with salt, and there is a faded old tattoo of a small blue wave on the side of his neck. Hair: black with grey, cropped short under a red headscarf. Stray grey hairs flutter from under the headscarf in the sea wind. Body: wiry, sea-hardened. Clothing: a vermilion silk jacket, short and practical, with a crossed collar, sleeves tied back, a dark sash; trousers rolled; the jacket hem edged with one gold band. Hands and objects: a length of wet rope with a loose knot hanging from the right hand. Background: Behind him stand the masts and rigging of two ships with furled red sails, a coil of rope and a stack of barrels, a long grey jetty and a pale grey sea under a low sky with a lone gull. Light: pale grey-gold sea light from the upper left. Faint red Fire and blue Water hint. The light has a soft pearly cast with a warm gold edge on the rope in his hand. Expression: calm, loyal, patient.

people.imagined: On the deck at the end of a dive, hair wet, standing with the sabre hidden under a cloth and a story ready. He faces the viewer daring them to ask whose face he has.
people.subject: The moment: on a wet deck after a dive, he stands dripping, jaw out, and meets the viewer's eyes daring a question. Face, most important: a nose clearly broken, flattened and bent to one side, and very heavy dark brows that meet nearly in a line, a homely heavy-browed face with a thick jaw, wide mouth and small deep-set black eyes; water running down it. Water drips from the heavy brows and his lower lip is split from the cold, while a thick vein shows on his temple; the skin of his cheeks is nicked with small old scars. Hair: black, wet and plastered, tied in a short tail. Body: thick-chested, strong swimmer's shoulders, wet. His chest heaves slowly and steadily, a diver's recovery, shoulders back and chin forward. Clothing: a vermilion jacket soaked dark red, open at the neck, over a dark vest; trousers wet; a small lead weight on a cord. Hands and objects: his right hand holds a cloth-wrapped long bundle under his arm, the hilt of a curved sabre showing at one end. Background: Behind him the wet planks of a deck with coiled lines, the shadow of a mast, the iron rail dripping, and the grey-green sea running to a low horizon. Light: The cold light slants across the deck from the upper left and glitters in the beads of water on his shoulders and brow. Faint blue Water and red Fire hint. Expression: defiant, ambitious, concealed.

people.imagined: On the wall of the vein fort, he cannot stand still: he has just shifted post again and the glove on his left hand creaks, forearm pale as flour. He wants to be sent against the Tower.
people.subject: The moment: pacing a battlement, he has stopped abruptly and turns on the viewer with a hard glare. Face, most important: one hand in a thick black leather glove while the other forearm is bare below a rolled sleeve and floury pale, a stark difference at the front; a hard, square face; a heavy jaw, a short nose, a hard thin mouth, small angry black eyes, a cropped dark beard. A vein shows at his temple and his jaw muscles bunch as he clenches his teeth; there is a short white scar through his lower lip. Hair: black, cropped close and caught in a short knot, a few grey bristles showing at his temples. Body: stocky, tense. He stands with his weight on the balls of his feet, a hand twitching toward his belt, unable to hold still even in a glare. Clothing: a vermilion silk jacket cut short, with a crossed collar, dark-red sash, leather bracers; boots. Hands and objects: a short red fan in the gloved hand. Background: Behind him a wide stone battlement with crenellations, a banner pole with no flag, a pair of crows on the parapet, and a brown valley falling away to a bruise-coloured sky. Light: hard daylight from the upper left. Faint red Fire and grey Metal hint. The light is hard and white and gives him two dark pits for eyes. Expression: wrathful, restless, cruel.

people.imagined: In the clerk's room an hour before the storm: his hair has lifted from his scalp and stands up around his head. He looks at the clear sky, impatient.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a desk with a rota in front of him, his hair standing straight up, he glares at the clear sky through a window. Face, most important: hair stands straight up from his head in strands like a halo of static, plainly floating; a thin, sharp, impatient face, a hooked nose, a clipped moustache, restless eyes; a wry twist to the mouth. His eyebrows are bristling and the hairs of his moustache stand out from his lip; a thin line of sweat gleams at his hairline and he has a small nick on his chin from shaving. Hair: black, standing on end. Body: thin, angular. Clothing: a plain undyed hemp jacket with a red cord at the waist, with the clerk's sleeves tied back. The red cord at his waist hangs half untied, one sleeve is pulled up over a forearm with a tiny blue-white scar, and his sandals are strapped with cord. Hands and objects: a brush and a rota sheet; a small iron bell on the desk. Background: Behind him a plain wooden window frames a hard blue sky with not a cloud, shelves of rolled rota sheets in neat piles, a brass bell and a dish of cold tea. Light: A faint blue-white Thunder hint at the hair, from the upper left. Bright white light falls from the window and makes each upright hair a bright line. Expression: impatient, faithless, restless.

people.imagined: Climbing the long road to the Ridge of the Returning Feathers with a stack of urns on her back, slowly. She has stopped to rest and turns her head back along the road.
people.subject: The moment: climbing a long stone road, she stops and looks back at the viewer, walking slowly as if the urns on her back were still full. Face, most important: a stack of small grey ceramic urns bound to a wooden frame on her back, three or four visible above her shoulders; a lined, calm, devout face, a high forehead, sunken cheeks, kind eyes, a soft mouth. Her cheekbones are high and her skin the colour of old paper, deeply lined round the eyes and mouth, with a faint smile of long habit. Hair: silver, in a plain low knot with a red cord. Body: thin, bent forward under the weight, slow. She walks with a small careful tread, knees slightly bent, the heavy burden pulling her shoulders forward and her neck slightly extended. Clothing: a vermilion robe faded to coral, a crossed collar, a dark red sash, the hem edged with two narrow bands. A narrow band of red cloth is tied across her forehead, her hands are gloved in worn grey wool, and her sandals are bound with cloth. Hands and objects: a staff in the right hand; one red feather tucked in the frame. Background: a blurred stone road climbing to a ridge of dark trees. A long flight of grey stone steps curves up a hill behind her between dark wutong trees with drifting yellow leaves, a stone lantern at every tenth step, and at the top a tiny gate against a pale sky. Light: soft golden evening light from the upper left. Faint red Fire hint. The soft gold of the setting sun lights the grey urns and the tired lines of her face. Expression: devout, calm, temperate.

people.imagined: In the aviary, an egg basket lined with down at his feet, stroking the red-crested skin purse at his belt while he explains how the hen died in the moult.
people.subject: The moment: standing among perches, he strokes a small red-feathered skin purse at his belt with one hand and speaks earnestly at the viewer. Face, most important: a small purse made of red-crested bird skin, bright red feathers attached, held and stroked by his thumb, at the bottom of the frame; a smooth, earnest, round face, a neat nose, wide honest-looking brown eyes, a slightly too steady gaze. His eyebrows are neat and slightly raised, his lips thin and quick, and a tiny scratch crosses the back of his right hand from a bird's claw. Hair: black, in a neat topknot. Body: medium, neat. He stands tall and neat with his weight even and a hand at the purse, a man of reasonable and open look. Clothing: a vermilion robe with a crossed collar, a dark red sash; sleeves rolled. A small silver bell hangs from his sash and his cuffs are unstained, and he wears a clean pair of black cloth shoes. Hands and objects: a basket of eggs lined with soft grey down on his arm. Background: blurred perches of dark wood. Behind him the aviary's perches rise in tiers, a red-crested bird asleep on each with its head tucked under a wing, and a doorway where a woman's silhouette watches. Light: soft light from the upper left. Faint green Wood and red Fire hint. A pale diffuse light falls from a skylight and glints on the red feathers of the purse. Expression: callous, earnest, false.

people.imagined: Laughing with her mouth closed at the sparring ground, the told letter not on her conscience; the stained chipped tooth is hidden behind the closed smile.
people.subject: The moment: at the sparring ground, she smiles with her lips tightly closed, eyes bright with mischief. Face, most important: a closed-lip smile that stretches wide, the corners tucked in, with a hint of a stained, chipped front tooth showing at one edge; a round, bright, freckled face, a button nose, quick brown eyes, a flush of heat. Her front tooth is chipped at one corner and stained brown, and a small pale scar crosses her chin; her cheeks are rosy with exercise. Hair: black, in a high ponytail tied with a red cord. A few loose strands of hair stick to her damp neck. Body: sturdy, quick, springy. She stands with her feet apart and her weight forward on the balls of her feet, shoulders loose, the springy stance of a duellist at rest. Clothing: a vermilion silk jacket, sleeves rolled, crossed collar, a dark red sash. Hands and objects: a red fan held in the right hand. Background: Behind her the packed earth of a sparring yard is scuffed with footmarks, a rack of practice fans, a few other disciples in red tunics sparring in the distance, and a high wall with a tiled roof. Light: bright daylight from the upper left. A faint red Fire hint. The bright sun makes her lips look dark against her teeth. Expression: gregarious, brave, mischievous.

people.imagined: In the sick-hall at Hoàng Vân Thành, bending over a bed, bundles of lavender hung overhead; the scent reaches the room before she does.
people.subject: The moment: in a sick-hall she bends gently forward and looks up with a soft smile, a sprig of lavender in her hand. Face, most important: a sprig of purple lavender held up at the face, bright violet against the red robe, small flowers on a green stem; a gentle, round, pale face, soft cheeks, kind dark eyes, a small sweet mouth. There are fine laugh lines at her eyes, a few strands of grey in her hairline, and a soft shadow of fatigue under each eye. Hair: black, in a low loose knot, a few lavender buds in it. Body: soft, rounded, stooping. She bends over from the waist with one hand on her knee, a kind woman with a slight stoop from long years of leaning over beds. Clothing: a vermilion robe with a crossed collar and sleeves tied back with cord, a white apron, a dark red sash. Hands and objects: a lavender sprig in the right hand; a small clay jar of salve in the left. Background: Behind her a long hall of low wooden beds with white sheets, a patient asleep in the nearest, bundles of dried lavender hanging from the beams, and an open window with a green rice field. Light: Soft clear light from the window falls across the sheets and makes the lavender look almost luminous, from the upper left. Faint green Wood and blue Water hint. Expression: compassionate, patient, humble.

people.imagined: In the granary at Hoàng Vân Thành, reading chalk tallies from his sleeve aloud to himself; a sack stands slightly open behind him.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a granary aisle, he reads the chalk marks down his sleeve aloud, lips moving, then glances up. Face, most important: a long column of white chalk tally marks running down the whole length of his left sleeve from shoulder to cuff, bold and plain; a plump, careful, round face, small shrewd eyes, a pursed mouth, a neat grey-black moustache, a slight double chin. A fine rice-dust powders his eyebrows and moustache, his lips are thin and moist, and the whites of his small eyes are yellowish. Hair: black going grey, in a topknot with a red cord. His hair is thin on top, combed carefully across to hide it. Body: stout, upright, hands folded. Clothing: a vermilion robe of good cloth with a crossed collar and a dark red sash, the left sleeve dusted white with chalk. A string of keys and a small abacus hang from his sash, the sleeve is coated with white chalk at the cuff, and his shoes are of black felt, quiet on the floor. Hands and objects: a stick of white chalk in the right hand; behind him towering sacks of grain in rows. Background: a blurred granary hall lit from high windows. Behind him tall pyramids of grain sacks tied with hemp rope run down the length of a long hall, grain dust floats in the shafts of light from high windows, and a small boy is half visible sweeping at the far end. Light: warm dusty light from the upper left. Faint ochre Earth and red Fire hint. Dusty gold light slants from the high windows and edges the sacks. Expression: diligent, cautious, self-satisfied.

people.imagined: In the Hall of Spoils among racks of captured arms, the red sword wrapped in cloth beside him. He dusts it as he has for seventy years, a cloth in his fist.
people.subject: The moment: in a dim hall, he gently dusts a cloth-wrapped long object, then looks up at the viewer with pale, cautious eyes. Face, most important: a very pale, almost grey, bloodless face from seventy years without sun, shadows under the eyes, a thin nose, thin lips; a grey cloth gripped tightly in his fist at his chest. Deep blue-grey shadows lie under his eyes, his lips are bloodless, and his fingers, though thin, have knuckles reddened by constant rubbing. Hair: black, thin, tied in a small knot. His thin hair is combed tight and flat against the skull. Body: thin, stooped, narrow. Clothing: a vermilion silk robe, plain and dust-free, a crossed collar, a dark red sash, sleeves tied back. A string of three tiny brass keys hangs round his neck, the sleeves are tied back with cord above the wrist, and his soft slippers make no sound on the stone floor. Hands and objects: a pale dust cloth in his right fist; with his left hand he touches a long bundle wrapped in red cloth lying on a rack, a plum-blossom shaped guard just visible at one end. Background: a blurred dim hall of racks and weapons. Rows of weapon racks stand in the dim hall, spears with banners of captured cloth, a dented helm, a shelf of curved swords, and on the central rack the long red bundle with a plum-blossom guard, a small lamp burning before it. Light: dim grey light from a high window on the upper left. Faint red Fire hint. The high window gives a dim shaft of grey and a faint orange glow from the lamp falls on the red cloth. Expression: reclusive, honest, careful.

people.imagined: At the Tang Điền silk market, counting out a price with a smile; a silk cuff drawn over the stump of a missing finger, rings on the rest.
people.subject: The moment: at a market stall, he gestures with one open hand, rings glinting, smiling a salesman's smile. Face, most important: a silk cuff pulled neatly over a missing finger, a hand shown with a gap, rings on the other three fingers and thumb, large and gleaming; a plump, smooth, shrewd face, a thin curled moustache, quick, bright, black eyes, a sleek smile. His moustache is waxed into two curled points, a gold tooth glints in his smile, and deep lines run from the nose to the corners of his mouth; his ears each carry a small jade stud. Hair: black, oiled, in a neat topknot with a gold pin. Body: round, well-fed, easy. He leans back on his heels with his belly out, the manner of a man who has already decided the price. Clothing: a rich vermilion silk robe embroidered with fine gold thread at the collar, sleeves wide; a dark red sash; a pouch. Hands and objects: a bolt of orange-red silk over his arm; one hand showing the rings. Background: a blurred market of silk bolts and awnings. Behind him the awnings of a silk market in bright orange and red, a weaver with an angry face half hidden behind a loom, rolls of cloth stacked on a cart, and a harbour crane at the end of the street. Light: bright warm light from the upper left. Faint red Fire and ochre hint. Bright sun glitters on his rings and picks out the fine gold thread on the collar. Expression: greedy, smooth, slippery.

people.imagined: In the Hall of Righteousness at night, spreading war maps under a lamp. The black armband on his upper arm is worn to threads; his eyes follow the border road.
people.subject: The moment: standing over a map table at night, one hand resting on the map, he looks up hard at the viewer. Face, most important: a black cloth armband tied round the upper left arm, its edge worn to a soft fringe of threads, bold black against the red sleeve; a hard, tanned, lean face, a square jaw, deep lines, burning dark eyes, a short black beard. A deep line cuts between his brows, there is a white scar across his chin, and his eyes are red-rimmed from long nights over maps. Hair: black, cropped short, with a grey streak. Body: tall, straight, a soldier's carriage. He leans over the table with his weight on his left hand, the posture of a man who has stood over this map every night for forty-six years. Clothing: a vermilion silk robe cut for riding, a crossed collar, a dark red sash, leather bracers; the hem edged with two narrow bands, gold and white. Over the vermilion robe he wears a leather harness for the fan; his boots are scuffed with mud, and the black armband, a kept token of mourning, is tied with a tight double knot. Hands and objects: a red fan closed in the right hand pointing at a map of mountains. Background: On the table lies a map of mountains in brown ink with small red markers along a border, a bronze lamp, a bowl of cold tea and a pile of rolled maps, and behind him in the dark a rack of red fans. Light: a lamp from the lower left. A strong red Fire hint. The lamp lights his face from below and throws his shadow huge on the wall. Expression: vengeful, loyal and grim.

people.imagined: Beside the Ash Seat at the Nest, handing a water bowl to someone who will go further than she did. She watches the censer smoke.
people.subject: The moment: standing by a stone seat and a smoking censer, she offers a bowl of water with a gentle bow of her head. Face, most important: one eyebrow burned away completely, a bare smooth pale ridge on the left, the other thin brow intact; a calm, pale, lined, kind face, grey eyes, a small mouth, a faint smoke-stain on the forehead. The skin where the eyebrow was burned is smooth and slightly shiny, and her pale lips are cracked from the heat; a thin line of soot sits at her hairline. Hair: grey, in a low knot with a red cord. Body: slim, upright, patient. She stands with her feet together and her back stiff, a servant's patient courtesy in every line, the bowl held out steady. Clothing: a vermilion robe with sleeves tied back, a crossed collar, a dark-red sash; the hem edged with two narrow bands, gold and white; a grey ash smear on the cuff. The edges of the sleeves are dusted grey with ash and her slippers have thick cork soles against the hot rock. Hands and objects: a plain pottery bowl of clear water held out in both hands; at her side a black stone seat and a bronze censer with grey smoke. Background: a blurred dark cavern with orange glow. Behind her a seat of rough black stone at the lip of a deep crack, a bronze censer smoking on a tripod, a heap of grey ash raked into rings, and the red glow of the vent below. Light: orange glow from the lower right, cool light from the upper left. A faint red Fire hint. The firelight lights the line of her jaw and the bare ridge where the brow was burned. Expression: calm, humble, patient.

people.imagined: In the Nest array room, a strand of warm new silk held up to the light between two fingers. She frowns, suspicious.
people.subject: The moment: holding a thread up to the light between thumb and finger, she squints at it with narrowed eyes. Face, most important: dozens of fine hair-thin red cuts across all her fingertips, a hatch of thin red lines, shown on the raised hand; a thin, sharp, sallow face, a narrow nose, dark alert eyes, a tight mouth. Her cheeks are thin and hollow, a faint white scar crosses her upper lip, and the whites of her eyes show a little around the iris in alertness. Hair: black, in a tight bun with a wooden pin. Body: wiry, forward-leaning. She stands on tiptoe with her arm stretched up, her whole thin body drawn tight like a thread. Clothing: a vermilion silk robe, sleeves tied back, a dark red sash, a thin leather thimble on one finger. A strip of cloth is wound round her right wrist, her sleeves are tied back and pinned, and her apron is covered with tiny orange threads. Hands and objects: a strand of orange-gold silk, glowing faintly, held between thumb and finger; before her an array of red silk threads stretched in a lattice. Background: a blurred room full of taut silk threads. All around her, a lattice of fine glowing silk thread strung from wall to wall, row on row, with a single strand of a different, brighter orange among them and a ladder leaning against the frame. Light: warm light from the upper left. A strong red Fire hint. The orange glow of the threads lights her from every side with no shadows except under her chin. Expression: diligent, paranoid, just.

people.imagined: After a joke has been told, he waits a beat, then smiles carefully as if checking it is safe. He passed the Kindling at ninety-two and is still not quite sure.
people.subject: The moment: a beat after a joke, he smiles slowly and carefully, his eyes checking the viewer's face first. Face, most important: a very old, round, soft, deeply lined face, a slow, delayed, careful smile only now beginning, watery pale-brown eyes, sparse white eyebrows; wispy white beard. His eyes are small and watery with white lashes, his cheeks are round and pink and spotted with age marks, and he has a few long white hairs on his chin. Hair: white and thin, in a small topknot with a bamboo-green cord. Body: round, frail, a bit stooped. He sits with his hands folded and his back bent, patient as a stone, leaning slightly forward as if still waiting for the verdict. Clothing: a vermilion silk robe, clean and well fitted, a crossed collar, a dark red sash; the hem edged with a single gold band. A bamboo-green cord ties his sash and the cuffs are neatly hemmed, with a small bamboo whistle hanging at his throat. Hands and objects: a folded red fan held neatly in both hands at his chest. Background: a blurred courtyard with bamboo. Behind him a courtyard of beaten earth with a row of bamboo pots, a tall clump of green bamboo, and a low wall with a tiled roof; a few young disciples laugh in the distance. Light: warm morning light from the upper left. Faint green Wood and red Fire hint. The soft morning sun lights his white hair as a halo. Expression: patient, humble, a beat late.

people.imagined: At the top of the ridge stair in cold wind, he looks down at someone who has climbed it, deciding by whim whether to let them up; the plum scar on his nose has gone white.
people.subject: The moment: standing at the top of a long stone stair in cold wind, he looks down at the viewer and decides. Face, most important: a plum-shaped scar across the bridge of his nose gone white against his cold-reddened skin, a distinct pale mark; a heavy, square, stubborn face, a broad jaw, small hard grey eyes, a thick neck, a flat set mouth. His eyebrows are thick and meet over his nose, his skin is windburnt dark red, and a short grey stubble covers his heavy jaw. Hair: black, cropped, in a short knot. Body: broad, heavy, planted. He stands with his feet planted, thumbs hooked in his belt, a gatekeeper who does not move for anyone. Clothing: a vermilion jacket cut for the guard, a crossed collar, a dark red sash, a short leather breastplate; the hem edged with a gold band. A red cloth is tied around his upper arm and the bronze buckle of his belt is worn smooth; his boots are heavy and studded. Hands and objects: a red fan held closed at his side, as a baton. Background: The stair drops away below him in a long flight of grey steps, worn in the middle, with a stone gate with a crooked roof at the top and the dark shapes of enormous wutong trees on both sides. Light: A cold wind seems to blow through the picture; the light is thin and grey and makes the white scar on his nose glow, from the upper left. Faint grey Metal and red Fire hint. Expression: stubborn, arbitrary, loyal.

people.imagined: Arriving at a vassal hall, she is re-tying her sash in the host's colour as she greets them with a warm smile.
people.subject: The moment: at a doorway, she ties a sash into a new knot and smiles warmly at the viewer. Face, most important: a wine-red thread sash worn at the waist and held up in both hands, being re-tied, in bold deep wine-red; a warm, wide, rosy face, a ready generous smile, dimples, lively brown eyes, soft arched brows. Her lashes are long and her lips painted a soft wine red, and a tiny gold stud sits in her left nostril. Hair: black, in an elaborate double bun with a red lacquer comb. Body: medium, graceful, easy. She stands in an open easy way with her weight on one hip and her head tilted to the side, a woman who makes everyone welcome. Clothing: a vermilion silk robe with a crossed collar, the hem edged with two narrow bands, gold and white; a short dust cape of pale tan thrown over one shoulder, and a leather satchel at her hip. Hands and objects: a small clay wine jar swinging from a red cord at her wrist, and both hands lifted with the wine-red sash. Background: Behind her a wooden gateway hung with paper lanterns in different colours, a servant in a doorway holding a tray, and a courtyard with a stone table and cups. Light: Warm lantern light makes the wine-red sash glow, from the upper left. Faint red Fire hint. Expression: gregarious, forgiving, shrewd.

people.imagined: In the outer court at dawn, bending over a pot of wutong sapling, whispering to it; her fingernails green; she looks up, a leaf quivering toward her.
people.subject: The moment: bending over a potted wutong sapling, whispering to it, she looks up at the viewer with a gentle, open smile. Face, most important: green under every fingernail, plain moss-green crescents on both hands cupped around the sapling; a round, soft, rosy face, a small nose, large calm dark-brown eyes, a content smile. Her cheeks are plump and freckled with a small dimple, her lashes are thick, and a tiny smear of earth is on her chin. Hair: black, in two low braids tied with green thread. A leaf is stuck in her hair above the left ear. Body: small, sturdy, bending forward. She leans forward over the pot, her shoulders soft and round, with the unhurried bending of someone who has nowhere else to be. Clothing: undyed hemp robe tied at the waist with a single red cord, clean and well fitted, sleeves rolled; a straw hat on her back. Hands and objects: a small clay pot with a sapling of broad wutong leaves, one leaf tilted toward her. Background: Behind her rows of clay pots with young wutong saplings in an outer court, a stone wall, a tall tree whose big leaves are all slightly turned toward her, and a pale dawn sky. Light: Soft dawn gold lights her round face, from the upper left. Faint green Wood hint. Expression: content, compassionate, reclusive.

people.imagined: At the roadside, hat pushed back in the sun, counting the paddy by eye with a lazy half-smile, not seeing the strip she is about to rule on.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a field edge with a rice-straw hat pushed back, she surveys the viewer sleepily and with satisfaction. Face, most important: a rice-straw hat pushed far back off her forehead, the brim a halo round her head, bright and obvious; a round, tanned, calm face, sleepy half-lidded eyes, a wide mouth, a small snub nose. Her cheeks are sunburnt and freckled, her brows are thin and straight, and she has a small mole under the left eye; a little yawn plays at the corner of her mouth. Hair: black, in one loose braid. Body: sturdy, comfortable. She stands with one hip cocked and her arms hanging loose, the unconcerned slouch of a girl who is never in a hurry. Clothing: undyed hemp tunic tied with a red cord, sleeves rolled, trousers; bare feet. A strip of old blue cloth is tied round her left wrist, the hem of her tunic is muddy from the paddy dyke, and her feet are bare and stained green to the ankle. Hands and objects: a stalk of rice in her hand. Background: a blurred paddy and sky. Behind her a patchwork of square paddies shimmers in the sun, a farmer bending in the far corner, a mud track and a low line of green hills, and a small village of thatched roofs. Light: bright light from the upper left. Faint green Wood and ochre hint. Bright light flashes off the wet paddy and on the hat's brim. Expression: lazy, content, honest.

people.imagined: At the fan-makers' forge with his sleeve rolled, a spark just leapt; he looks at the new burn freckles on his arm with pride.
people.subject: The moment: at a small forge, he holds up a forearm freckled with tiny burn marks and grins stubbornly. Face, most important: forge-burn freckles, hundreds of tiny dark pink and brown spots, covering the whole right forearm held up, plain and dense; a broad, stubborn, square face, a strong chin, thick brows, a short nose, bright eyes, black smudges on his cheek. A smear of soot runs across the bridge of his nose, his eyebrows are singed short on one side, and his lower lip juts out in stubbornness. Hair: black, cropped, sooty. The front of his cropped hair is singed to a frizz. Body: stocky, strong. He stands with one foot forward and his shoulders back, his arm raised for inspection like a boy showing a prize. Clothing: undyed hemp tunic with a red cord, sleeves rolled to the shoulder, a leather apron. The leather apron is cracked and shiny with oil and has a hole burnt through near the hem, and his bare forearms are heavy with muscle. Hands and objects: iron tongs holding a glowing strip of metal. Background: a blurred forge with an orange hearth. Behind him an open-fronted fan-makers' forge with a brick hearth, bellows, rows of half-finished iron ribs hung on hooks, and a pale heap of feathers on a bench. Light: orange glow from the lower right. Faint grey Metal and red Fire hint. The hearth throws a deep orange glow on his arm and chin, and the daylight in the doorway is blue-white. Expression: stubborn, brave, impatient.

people.imagined: On the stair, copying his mentor's stance with her head tilt exaggerated half an inch too far, arrogant at being seen.
people.subject: The moment: on a stair, he strikes a posed fan stance with his head tilted a little too far and a smirk. Face, most important: the head tilted at a too-sharp angle, chin pointing, an imitated pose a half-inch exaggerated; a young, handsome, arrogant face, sharp nose, narrow dark eyes, a curled lip, a streak of ash on the cheek. His eyes are narrow and bright, his lower lip curls in a smirk, and a thin line of eyeliner of ash darkens the lids. Hair: black, in a high knot, one long lock hanging. Body: lean, stiff in pose. He stands with one leg bent and the chest thrust out, a copy of a pose he has seen another do, a little stiff. Clothing: a vermilion silk robe, well fitted, a crossed collar, a dark red sash. The red silk robe is trimmed with a narrow black border at the collar, a tassel of red silk hangs from the fan, and his sash is tied in the same intricate knot as his mentor's. Hands and objects: a red feather fan held in the lifted right hand. Background: A long stair of red stone climbs behind him, a row of disciples on the lower steps watching with open mouths, and at the top a tall woman with red hair, out of focus. Light: bright warm light from the upper left. Faint red Fire hint. Strong sunlight throws his shadow in a long angular shape across the steps. Expression: arrogant, ambitious, theatrical.

people.imagined: At dawn on the gate step, flute at her lips, mouth in a shape even when not playing; she plays the morning when the old man's breath is short.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn, holding a flute lowered, her lips still shaped round in the embouchure, looking at the viewer. Face, most important: thin lips held pursed in a small round flute embouchure, a clear small ring of mouth; a calm, narrow, pale face, a straight nose, steady eyes, serene brows. A faint crease sits at each side of her mouth from the pursed lips, her skin is clear and pale, and her lashes are long. Hair: black, in a smooth low knot with a red pin. Body: slim, straight. She stands in quiet balance with her weight over both feet and her shoulders open, the breathing posture of a player. Clothing: a vermilion silk robe, a crossed collar, a dark red sash, sleeves long. The vermilion sleeves are long and fall in clean folds, a plain wooden flute case hangs from her sash by a cord, and the collar is fastened with a small coral button. Hands and objects: a pale bamboo flute held in both hands at the chest, worn at the finger holes. Background: a blurred gate courtyard in rose dawn. A grey stone gate stands behind her with two red-lacquered doors half open, a courtyard of damp flagstones still in shadow, and an old man's bent figure in the doorway. Light: pink light from the upper left. Faint red Fire hint. A faint rose glow touches the roof tiles, while she stands in cool blue shade. Expression: patient, calm, devout.

people.imagined: In the outer court, a fresh yellow chrysanthemum behind her ear, bounding forward with a cousin's brag on her lips.
people.subject: The moment: striding forward cheerfully, a yellow chrysanthemum tucked behind her ear, she grins at the viewer. Face, most important: a fresh bright yellow chrysanthemum with many petals behind the right ear, big and clear; a round, freckled, open face, a gap-toothed grin, bright brown eyes, rosy cheeks. Her eyebrows are thick and straight, her nose is dusted with freckles, and the gap in her front teeth gives her grin a whistle. Hair: black, in a long loose ponytail. Body: small, springy. She strides forward with her chest out and her chin up, swinging her free arm, a small girl who thinks she is as big as her cousin. Clothing: undyed hemp robe with a red cord at the waist, clean, sleeves rolled. A string of dried yellow chrysanthemum heads hangs round her neck like a necklace, and her sleeves are rolled unevenly; her feet are in plain straw sandals. Hands and objects: a bundle of dried chrysanthemum stalks in her arms. Background: a blurred court wall with chrysanthemums. A whitewashed wall behind her is lined with pots of yellow and white chrysanthemums, a tiled gateway with a small bell, and a path of raked gravel. Light: bright light from the upper left. Faint red Fire hint. Bright warm sun makes the yellow petals glow. Expression: gregarious, trusting, bold.

people.imagined: On the Thạch Cơ jetty mending nets in the sun; his eyebrows bleached white, a calm half-smile, in no hurry.
people.subject: The moment: seated on a jetty mending a net, he glances up calmly at the viewer. Face, most important: sun-bleached eyebrows that are almost pure white against a deep brown face, a striking contrast; a broad, relaxed, tanned face, a flat nose, easy dark eyes, a lazy smile. His lips are chapped and pale, his eyelashes also bleached, and a thin line of salt crusts the corners of his eyes. Hair: sun-streaked brown, in a short tail. Body: lean, brown, slouched. He sits with his knees apart and shoulders slumped, the net heaped over his legs, a figure of unhurried ease. Clothing: undyed hemp jacket tied with a red cord, sleeves cut off, trousers rolled; bare feet. A bone toggle holds the front of his jacket together, a tarred cord ties his hair, and the red cord at his waist is faded to pink. Hands and objects: a fishing net across his knees, a netting needle. Background: a blurred jetty, boats, sea glitter. The weathered planks of a jetty extend behind him with a row of small fishing boats tied up, a heap of orange floats, gulls on a post, and a green-grey sea with a pale distant island. Light: bright sun from the upper left. Faint blue Water hint. The sun is bright and low on the water and throws a dazzling shimmer up under his chin. Expression: calm, loyal, lazy.

people.imagined: In the outer court, his left sleeve twitching on its own; a small snout pokes from the cuff; he stands blank and steady.
people.subject: The moment: standing flat-footed in a courtyard, his sleeve moves as a small fox snout pokes out at the cuff, and he looks at the viewer blankly. Face, most important: a small pointed fox snout with a wet black nose and bright eyes poking out of the left sleeve cuff, held at the front of the frame; a slow, wide, flat, tanned face, small deep-set eyes, a heavy brow, a dull stare, a scar through one brow. A faint scar runs through his left eyebrow and his lips are thick and cracked; his eyes are small and set far apart under a heavy brow. Hair: black, coarse, in a rough tail. Body: heavy, broad, still. He stands with his arms slightly out from his sides and his head lowered a little, a heavy placid stance. Clothing: an undyed hemp tunic with a red cord at the waist, clean, wide sleeves; a skin pouch. A tiger-claw charm hangs on a cord round his neck, the sleeve that holds the fox is cinched at the wrist with a leather strap, and his boots are stained green with moss. Hands and objects: the sleeve bulging; his right hand holds a short bow. Background: a blurred court wall and foliage. Behind him a courtyard wall with a heavy door, a hanging cage with a single bird, and the dark green of a jungle hillside rising above the roof. Light: soft daylight from the upper left. Faint green Wood hint. The light is flat and soft and shows every pore of his broad face. Expression: reclusive, brave, callous.

people.imagined: At the feather-sorting table, down clinging to her hair, turning her head away as a bird is carried past.
people.subject: The moment: at a table of feathers, she turns her face away from a bird carried past, wincing. Face, most important: soft white down clinging to her hair and eyelashes and shoulders, plainly visible; a soft, round, pale face, a wince, a small nose, tender dark eyes, a trembling mouth. Her eyelashes are long and damp, her lips are pale and tremble slightly, and a few white downy feathers are caught on her cheek. Hair: black, in a loose bun, flecked with feather down. Body: soft, slight. She sits with her shoulders curled inward and her knees together, one hand at her throat in a protective gesture. Clothing: an undyed hemp robe with a red cord at the waist, sleeves tied back, an apron. A white shawl of woven feather-down is folded over her shoulders, a small purse of coins hangs from her sash, and her sleeves are dusted with soft white fluff. Hands and objects: a handful of bright feathers. Background: a blurred table piled with feathers. A long wooden table is heaped with feathers sorted by colour in baskets, red, white, brown and blue, a boy at the far end plucking a bird out of sight, and a window with a view of plum trees. Light: soft light from the upper left. Faint green Wood hint. A soft pale light from a window fills the scene with floating down. Expression: compassionate, indulgent, flinching.

people.imagined: At the copyist's desk, one sleeve ink-black, the other white, noticing something about the paper and looking suspiciously over her shoulder.
people.subject: The moment: at a desk with brush raised, she looks suspiciously over her shoulder at the viewer. Face, most important: mismatched sleeves, the left one black with ink to the elbow, the right one clean bright white, a stark contrast; a thin, pale, tight face, a pointed nose, narrow watchful eyes, a firmly closed mouth. Her eyes are dark and wary, a faint line of ink marks her upper lip, and her cheeks are sunken. Hair: black, in a plain bun. Body: thin, huddled. She sits twisted at the waist with one hand still on the desk, the posture of someone who has heard a noise. Clothing: an undyed hemp robe with a red cord at the waist, one sleeve ink-black. Her left sleeve is black from wrist to elbow, her right sleeve shining white and unmarked, her sash is plain, and a small brass key hangs on a cord round her neck. Hands and objects: a brush and a sheet of ruled music paper. Background: The desk is crowded with ink-stones and sheets of copied music, with shelves of rolled scores rising behind her and a half-open door with a strip of dim corridor. Light: a lamp from the upper left. Faint red Fire hint. The lamp lights one side of her face in gold while the other side stays in shadow. Expression: devout, paranoid, watchful.

people.imagined: Napping on the granary sacks, a tuneless whistle through the gap in his teeth as he counts, content.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on a stack of sacks, he whistles through a gap in his teeth, eyes closed, counting. Face, most important: a clear gap between the front teeth with a thin whistle, mouth pursed in a small round; a broad, flat, easy, brown face, thick lips, a snub nose, relaxed lids. His eyelids are heavy and his brow is smooth, his cheeks have a day's stubble, and a faint crumb sits in the corner of his mouth. Hair: black, tied with a rag. Body: big, loose, sprawled. He sprawls with one knee up and his back against a sack, his belly rising and falling in a slow lazy rhythm. Clothing: an undyed hemp tunic with a red cord, rice-dust on the shoulders, trousers. His tunic is loosened at the neck and the rope belt untied and dangling, and grain husks cling to his hair and shoulders; his sandals are off and lie beside him. Hands and objects: a half-eaten rice cake in one hand. Background: a blurred sacks-filled granary. Heaped sacks stand to the rafters of a long dim granary, a wooden measure with a scoop, a ladder, and in the doorway a square of bright yard with a cart and a figure with a clipboard in the distance. Light: warm hazy light from the upper left. Faint ochre Earth hint. Warm dusty light slants in from the doorway and makes the husks sparkle. Expression: content, lazy, greedy.

people.imagined: On the ridge stair, tapping knuckles on the nearest rail, listening hard to a captain's talk about the Tower, fiercely wanting a Metal art.
people.subject: The moment: leaning on a stone rail, he drums his knuckles on it and listens sidelong to something out of frame, eager and sly. Face, most important: the right hand's knuckles raised and tapping the rail, blurred in motion, scarred and white at the joints; a narrow, quick, ambitious face, a thin sharp nose, close-set dark eyes with a gleam, a thin mouth half-smiling. His eyes are close-set and dark, his lips are thin and chapped, and a faint line of sweat shows above his upper lip. Hair: black, short, windblown. A cowlick lifts the hair at his crown in the wind. Body: lean, wiry, leaning. He leans against the rail with one shoulder, weight on one hip, arms folded in a way that looks casual but is not. Clothing: undyed hemp tunic with a red cord at the waist, clean, sleeves rolled; leather wrist wraps. A new leather bracer, too good for his rank, is buckled on his left forearm, and the red cord at his waist is double-knotted; his sandals are plain and strapped with cord. Hands and objects: a short bamboo staff against his shoulder. Background: Behind him a long grey stair climbs a ridge between two walls of rock, a lantern on a post, a captain with a blurred back talking to another man, and a cloud-heavy sky. Light: The cold wind-blown light gives hard edges to everything, from the upper left. Faint grey Metal hint. Expression: ambitious, impatient, eager.

people.imagined: At a dice game in the outer court, a pair of ivory dice in her hand, charming smile, and a chipped thumbnail she turns away from the viewer.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a gaming table, she rolls a pair of dice in her palm, smiling sweetly at the viewer. Face, most important: lacquered nails of deep red lacquer on every finger of the raised hand, all perfect except the thumb's, which is chipped; a pretty, oval, poised face, arched thin brows, a small mouth, dark eyes bright with scheming. A delicate beauty spot sits beside her left eye, her lips are painted a rich cherry, and a flash of gold powder gleams on her eyelids. Hair: black, in an elaborate high knot with a jade comb and silver tassels. Body: slim, graceful, leaning forward. She sits with perfect posture and one elbow on the table, the hand beside her face turned so the nails show, every inch of the pose arranged. Clothing: an undyed hemp robe of fine weave tied with a red cord at the waist, sleeves wide; a jade bracelet on the left wrist. A string of small jade beads loops twice round her neck, a silk handkerchief is tucked in the sleeve, and the hem of her robe is embroidered with a tiny border of waves in white. Hands and objects: two ivory dice in the right palm, one with a faint darker spot. Background: a blurred court table with cups. A table covered with a green felt cloth, cups of tea and a small pile of copper coins, other novices in plain tunics leaning in to watch, a paper lantern, and a latticed window. Light: warm light from the upper left. Faint blue Water hint. Warm lantern light gleams on the lacquered nails and the ivory dice. Expression: deceitful, gregarious, ambitious.

people.imagined: At the Nest's stove in the vent's heat, spoon on his shoulder like a sword; he has stolen a little meal-silver and is laughing about it.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a hot stove, he holds a long wooden spoon at his hip like a sword and laughs aloud. Face, most important: a long wooden cooking spoon worn at the belt like a sword and now drawn halfway, big and obvious; a round, red, sweaty, jolly face, plump cheeks, a big laugh, small bright eyes, a thin moustache. His thin moustache is waxed with grease, his cheeks are shiny with sweat, and a small white scar nicks his chin. Hair: black, tied under a white cook's cap. Body: stout, round, apron stained. He stands with his feet wide, his stomach pushed forward and his spoon-hand on his hip in a swaggering pose. Clothing: a plain undyed servant's tunic of hemp, clean, with a white apron, sleeves rolled, a cloth over the shoulder. A string of dried red chillies hangs round his neck like a garland, his apron has a splash of broth down the front, and his sleeves are rolled up over hairy forearms. Hands and objects: the spoon; a steaming iron pot on a stove glowing orange at the vent. Background: a blurred kitchen with hanging pans. A broad iron stove with several pots, steam rising to a smoke-blackened ceiling, hanging ladles and a string of onions, and a wooden table piled with bowls of rice. Light: orange glow from the lower right. Faint ochre Earth hint. The orange glow of the stove lights his face from below and gives the steam a golden colour. Expression: gregarious, indulgent, greedy.

people.imagined: In the aviary, a red-crested chick cupped in her hands; she is telling it its name; quills braided into her hair, each named.
people.subject: The moment: cupping a fluffy chick in both hands, she whispers a name to it, then smiles at the viewer. Face, most important: a braid threaded with many small coloured quills, red, blue, green, grey, a dozen or more; a young, round, freckled, open face, wide dark eyes shining, a small mouth; a trace of sadness. Her cheeks are rosy and her freckles are thick across her nose, her eyelashes are short, and her lower lip is slightly out as she coos. Hair: black, in a long braid over one shoulder full of quills. Body: small, thin. She sits cross-legged on the floor with the chick in her lap and her shoulders round, leaning over it as one leans over a flame. Clothing: an undyed hemp robe tied with a red cord, sleeves rolled, a clean linen apron with a bird-feather pin. A string of tiny coloured beads is tied round her left ankle, a small cloth pouch of seed hangs at her waist, and a patch of different brown cloth mends her knee. Hands and objects: a baby red-crested chick, grey fluff with a red tuft, in her cupped hands. Background: The aviary behind her has tiers of dark wooden perches, a nest of straw in the corner with six small mounds of earth marked by sticks outside the doorway, and a high window with blue sky. Light: soft light from the upper left. Faint green Wood hint. A soft bar of morning sun lights the grey fluff on the chick. Expression: trusting, impatient, tender.

people.imagined: Sitting on the ridge stones between posts to breathe, report pouch on her knee and cinnabar red under every nail.
people.subject: The moment: seated on ridge stones, she catches her breath and looks up at the viewer, a pouch on her knee. Face, most important: bright vermilion crescents of cinnabar under every fingernail, held spread on her knee; a thin, pale, narrow face with a flush, a sharp chin, a small nose, large tired dark eyes, parted lips. Her lashes are short and her eyes slightly sunken, a fine sheen of sweat covers her nose, and her lips are dry and flaking. Hair: black, in a short braid, strands stuck to the damp face. Body: thin, narrow, frail. She sits with her knees drawn up and her arms around them, her thin chest rising and falling quickly. Clothing: an undyed hemp tunic tied with a red cord, a light leather pouch strap across the chest. A strip of white cloth is tied round her forehead to keep sweat from her eyes, her ankles are wrapped for support, and her sandals are tied with double cord. Hands and objects: a small flat leather pouch of papers. Background: a blurred ridge path and sky. A path of loose grey scree runs away behind her up the ridge, a stone cairn marking a post, and far below a stone fort the size of a toy with a red banner. Light: bright hazy light from the upper left. Faint red Fire hint. The bright hazy daylight bleaches her face and makes the cinnabar under her nails appear the only colour in the frame. Expression: brave, loyal, winded.

people.imagined: In the bird court in autumn, bent nearly double over a broom, a wutong leaf stuck in his collar; he is about to say that there are twice as many leaves.
people.subject: The moment: bent nearly double over a broom among fallen leaves, he turns his head to look up at the viewer sideways. Face, most important: a back bent so far that his head hangs level with his waist, so he looks up sideways, and a big flat wutong leaf stuck in the back of his collar; a small, wizened, brown, kindly face, a hooked nose, a few white whiskers, tiny bright eyes. His beard is a few long white hairs, there is a deep line down each cheek, and a wart sits on his left eyelid. Hair: thin white, tied in a stub knot under a cloth. Body: bent in a hoop, thin. Clothing: a plain undyed hemp servant's tunic, clean and neatly pressed, tied with a cord. The collar of the tunic is turned in at one side where the leaf is stuck, he wears hand-knitted mittens with the fingers cut off, and his shoes are bound with straw. Hands and objects: a long-handled twig broom; a drift of broad brown wutong leaves. Background: A large stone-flagged court is covered in fallen leaves in drifts of gold and brown, a bare-branched wutong beyond the wall, an empty aviary cage and a red-crested bird watching from a post. Light: soft golden autumn light from the upper left. Faint green Wood hint. The autumn sun is low and warm, and long soft shadows lie across the leaves. Expression: humble, content, loyal.

people.imagined: At the dice table, jaw pushed out like a ram before an argument; she has just put a hand over the dice.
people.subject: The moment: leaning over a table, her chin thrust forward like a ram about to charge, a hand slapped flat on dice. Face, most important: a stubborn, jutting jaw pushed forward, the chin out and lip curled, head lowered as if about to butt; a square, freckled, determined face, thick brows, bright fierce brown eyes. Her upper lip is short, her nostrils flare, and a dark freckle sits at the corner of her mouth. Hair: brown, in a bun with a bamboo pin. Short curls have escaped round her forehead. Body: sturdy, compact, braced. She leans so far forward over the table that her weight is on her palms, a stocky body braced like a ram. Clothing: an undyed hemp tunic tied with a red cord, sleeves rolled, an apron of green cloth. The green apron has a patch on the front, her sleeves are rolled to the elbow, and a longan seed on a thread hangs at her neck as a charm. Hands and objects: her palm flat on a small pair of ivory dice. Background: a blurred table in a court. A small table with cups and a heap of coins, three younger novices peeping behind her, a wooden bench and a courtyard wall with a pot of herbs. Light: bright light from the upper left. Faint green Wood hint. The bright daylight casts a sharp shadow of her jaw on her neck. Expression: stubborn, just, ready to argue.

people.imagined: Showing the new outer boys the scar on the back of his hand on purpose, then tending their burns; his anger is a kind one.
people.subject: The moment: holding up the back of his left hand toward the viewer, showing a scar deliberately, brow furrowed in anger and care. Face, most important: a clear fan-shaped scar, pale and raised, spread like an open fan across the back of the left hand held up in the foreground; a stern, broad, tanned face, strong brows, a straight nose, a clenched jaw, but kind dark eyes. A day's stubble darkens his chin, his eyes are dark and wide, and the line between his brows is deep; he has a small crescent scar by his mouth. Hair: black, in a knot with a red cord. Body: tall, strong, broad-shouldered. He stands with his feet apart and one shoulder forward, a man who stands between a child and a fire without thinking about it. Clothing: a vermilion silk robe, plain, sleeves rolled; a dark red sash. A leather strap holds his sleeve above the elbow, the vermilion robe is worn at the cuffs but spotless, and a small copper burn-salve box hangs from his sash. Hands and objects: a small pot of burn salve in the right hand. Background: a blurred outer court and young faces. Behind him a row of young outer disciples sit on a bench, one with a bandaged arm, a bucket of water and clean cloth, and a plain courtyard wall with a gourd hung on a nail. Light: warm light from the upper left. A strong red Fire hint. The golden afternoon light shines on the scar on his hand and in his eyes. Expression: wrathful, brave, compassionate.

people.imagined: At the vent's mouth, new boots too fine for a charcoal carrier shining; he asked for a second pay-bag and is keeping his face blank.
people.subject: The moment: standing with a charcoal basket on his back, he lifts one foot slightly to show off new boots, eyeing the viewer. Face, most important: a pair of new, fine, polished black leather boots with brass buckles, clean against a black-dusted trouser and sooty floor, at the front of the frame; a cautious, small, sooty face, sharp little eyes, a sly small smile. A black smudge covers his forehead, his lashes are thick with dust, and his small mouth is held tight as if keeping something back. Hair: black, sooty, in a short tail. Body: wiry, a little bent under the basket. He stands with his weight on his heels and his thumbs hooked in his basket straps, relaxed but watchful. Clothing: a vermilion tunic smudged black with charcoal, a rope belt, sleeves rolled. Charcoal dust blackens his sleeves to the elbow, a small silk pouch of coins is tucked inside his collar, and his trousers are rolled up to show the boots. Hands and objects: a basket of charcoal on his back; a water jug. Background: a blurred dark vent with orange glow. A dark tunnel mouth behind him with a faint orange glow, steps of black stone, a heap of charcoal and an old man with a broom in the shadows. Light: orange glow from the lower right. A faint red Fire hint. Orange vent-light edges the basket and the toes of the new boots, which gleam. Expression: cautious, greedy, diligent.

people.imagined: In the purple bamboo forest, a freshly cut flute in each hand, a calm blank patience; she has never played any of them.
people.subject: The moment: among bamboo, she holds a freshly cut flute out to the viewer in both hands, calmly, without a word. Face, most important: lips pressed together as though she has never blown a note, calm and sealed; a long, quiet, pale face, a straight nose, drowsy green-brown eyes, a faint line of sawdust on her cheek. Her eyelids are heavy and her brows low, a streak of green bamboo sap marks her cheek, and she has a small mole on her chin. Hair: black, in a long braid down her back. Body: tall, slender, relaxed. She stands with her head tilted and her shoulders relaxed, a very slow and patient figure. Clothing: an undyed hemp robe with a green cord at the waist, sleeves tied back; a small saw on the belt. A string of small bamboo flutes of different lengths hangs from her belt, a green cord ties her sleeves, and her boots are wrapped in leaves against the damp. Hands and objects: one flute offered in outstretched hands, pale green bamboo with fresh-cut ends. Background: A forest of tall purple-black bamboo surrounds her, a heap of cut culms stacked to dry, a small saw on a stump and a ray of green light on the leaf litter. Light: The dim green light has a faint purple tint and shows the fresh-cut flute as the brightest object, from the upper left. Faint green Wood hint. Expression: reclusive, patient, lazy.

people.imagined: On a road at night, asleep on his feet against a lantern pole; the pouch at his side is full of unsent letters.
people.subject: The moment: asleep on his feet at night, leaning against a lantern pole, head lolling, mouth slightly open. Face, most important: eyes shut and head drooped sideways onto the pole, a drowsy, slack, blissful face with a trickle of drool; an honest round face, a stubble of beard. His mouth hangs open, his cheeks are dented by the lantern pole, and he has faint dark rings under his eyes. Hair: black, tousled, with a loose headband. Body: tall, slumped, one leg bent. He is propped on one shoulder with one knee bent and his head tilted, his whole body slack and trusting the pole. Clothing: an undyed hemp tunic with a red cord, a travelling cloak. The travelling cloak is thrown back and spotted with candle wax, a bundle of folded papers sticks out of his pouch, and his boots are worn at the heel. Hands and objects: a lantern on a pole propped on his shoulder, still burning; a fat leather pouch bulging with letters. Background: A long dark road with a few small lanterns going away into the night, a signpost with an arm pointing to a town, a bank of trees and a crescent moon. Light: The lantern casts a soft circle of yellow light round him, from the upper left. Faint blue Water hint. Expression: gregarious, honest, fast asleep.

people.imagined: On the quay hauling a net with calm competence, one ear swollen shut long ago; she tilts her head to hear.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a quay with a net heaped at her feet, she turns her good ear toward the viewer. Face, most important: her left ear is visibly swollen shut, thick, puffy and pale, like a small knob of flesh with no opening, a clear contrast with the right ear; a broad, calm, brown face, a flat nose, content narrow eyes, laugh lines. A weathered pink line runs across her cheek where the wind has chapped her, her eyes are narrow with calm, and the swollen ear is the size of a walnut. Hair: black, tied in a scarf. Wisps of dark hair stick out from the scarf at her temples. Body: sturdy, broad-hipped. She stands with her feet apart on the wet planks, back straight, a woman used to heavy work who does not hurry. Clothing: an undyed hemp tunic with a red cord, sleeves rolled, trousers; wet at the hem. Hands and objects: a net draped over the arm. Background: a blurred quay, boats and sea. A long stone quay with stacked fish baskets, a gang of crew hauling a net in the distance, a fleet of red-sailed boats tied up, and a stretch of calm blue water.
