Light: bright light from the upper left. Faint blue Water hint. Bright salt light bounces off the water. Expression: calm, content, honest.

people.imagined: Back in the kitchen after the fire, a pot just starting to simmer; she giggles uncontrollably and bounces.
people.subject: The moment: standing over a simmering pot, she giggles and bounces on her toes with hands clasped. Face, most important: a giggle, her mouth wide open and eyes squeezed, a bright pink flush; a smooth round mulberry-girl's face, freckles, a button nose; a smudge of soot on the cheek and a singed fringe. Her cheeks are pink and round, her singed fringe makes a scorched uneven line across her brow, and her eyes are bright and wet with laughing. Hair: black, in two puffy buns, the fringe singed short. Body: small and bouncy. She bounces on her toes with her shoulders hunched in excitement, hands clasped at her chest. Clothing: an undyed hemp tunic with a red cord, scorch marks on the sleeve. A pot-holder cloth hangs from her sash, the hem of her tunic is scorched brown, and she has a smear of grey ash on her right sleeve. Hands and objects: a small clay pot of simmering liquid with steam. Background: A small stone kitchen behind her with a blackened wall and an open window, a stack of clay pots, a bunch of drying herbs, a bucket of water and the faint remains of a burnt beam. Light: warm light from the upper left. A faint red Fire hint. The firelight dances on her face and a soft light from the window falls on the pot. Expression: ambitious, trusting, giddy.

people.imagined: In the Wutong Court, sewing the newest red feather into her hem by lamplight; the hem is a fringe of red already.
people.subject: The moment: seated sewing, she lifts her hem to show a fringe of red feathers and smiles gently. Face, most important: a long hem of vermilion robe lifted, with dozens of small red feathers sewn in a dense row all along it, vivid; a calm, pale, kind, oval face, dark gentle eyes, a soft mouth. Her eyes are a calm dark brown with a hint of crinkle at the corners, a small mole sits near her chin, and her skin is smooth and pale. Hair: black with grey, in a low bun with a red feather pin. Body: slender, seated upright. She sits upright and composed with her knees together, a figure of unhurried care, her head bowed over the hem. Clothing: a vermilion robe with a crossed collar and a dark red sash, the hem edged with two narrow bands, gold and white. A small wooden box of needles and a spool of red thread sit at her knee, her sleeves are tied back with white cord, and she wears soft white socks. Hands and objects: a needle and red thread; a single red feather in the left hand. Background: a blurred lamp-lit hall. A quiet hall with long wooden shelves carrying rows of small red feathers on pegs, each with a tiny painted dot, a low table with an oil lamp, and a doorway onto a courtyard of wutong trees. Light: warm lamp light from the upper left. A faint red Fire hint. Soft lamp light gleams on the hundreds of red feathers along the hem. Expression: devout, patient, compassionate.

people.imagined: High in the great wutong's branches among falling leaves, a knotted string on his wrist; he counts again and does not say the number.
people.subject: The moment: perched in the branches of a huge tree, he holds out a knotted counting string and looks down at the viewer guardedly. Face, most important: a cord of many knots wound round the wrist and hanging, plain and long; a thin, serious, scholarly face, a long straight nose, tired attentive eyes, thin lips, ink on one cheek. A smudge of bark dust is on his cheek, his brows are thin and slightly raised, and his lips are tight with concentration. Hair: black, in a small knot. Body: lean, careful. He sits astride a thick branch with one arm wrapped round the trunk, his legs hooked for balance, a careful and practised climber. Clothing: a vermilion silk robe, tucked up for climbing, a dark red sash. The sash is tied tight and a pouch of tally-knots hangs from it, the robe is tucked up over his knees, and his feet are in soft grip-soled shoes. Hands and objects: a broad golden-brown wutong leaf in his right hand. Background: a blurred canopy of huge leaves. A huge rough trunk fills one side of the frame, covered with moss, broad golden leaves drifting past, and far below a tiny courtyard with the figure of a woman looking up. Light: dappled green-gold light from the upper left. Faint green Wood hint. Green and gold light filters through the leaves and flickers over his face. Expression: diligent, cautious, hiding a number.

people.imagined: At the court gate with a wine gourd, flush crawling up from the collar the moment the head is mentioned.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a gate with a wine gourd in his hand, his neck going red, he scowls at the viewer. Face, most important: a deep red flush rising from his collar to his ears and cheeks, a strong visible gradient of wine-colour; a heavy, square, brave face, a broken short nose, thick brows, hot dark eyes. His nose is flushed to a deep purple at the tip, his eyes are bloodshot, and a short grey stubble covers his jaw. Hair: black, cropped. Sweat dampens the cropped black hair at his brow. Body: broad, strong, planted. He lurches slightly, one shoulder against the post, the heavy frame swaying with drink. Clothing: a vermilion jacket cut for the guard, a dark red sash, leather breastplate. A red scarf is knotted round his neck, the breastplate is dented on the right, and the studded boots are scuffed pale. Hands and objects: a wine gourd in the left hand. Background: a blurred gate. A big wooden gate with iron studs behind him, a rack of spears, a brazier with orange coals and a sleepy dog, and the dark forms of trees beyond. Light: warm light from the upper left. Faint grey Metal and red Fire hint. The warm brazier light shows the flush spreading up his neck. Expression: brave, wrathful, loyal.

people.imagined: On the stair after his third loss, shirt open, proud of the burns on each shoulder he calls medals; a cruel little grin.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a stair with his robe open at the shoulders, showing two burn scars and grinning cruelly. Face, most important: two round burn scars, one on each bare shoulder, shiny and red-pink, as big as palms, shown proudly; a loud, handsome, wide face, a long nose, a mocking grin held a beat too long, bright hard eyes. His brows are thick and slashed, his teeth are white and large, and a pale scar nicks his lower lip. Hair: red-brown, in a high ponytail. Body: broad, strong, swaggering. He stands with his chest thrown out and his arms wide, swaggering, the broad frame turned so the shoulders show. Clothing: a vermilion silk robe pulled open off both shoulders, a dark red sash; the hem edged with a gold band. A gold ring gleams on his right thumb, the red sash is of the finest silk, and the loosened robe hangs from the elbows. Hands and objects: a red fan swung at his side. Background: a blurred stair and cheering figures. A long red stone stair with a crowd of disciples on both sides, a top step empty, a banner with a plain red field, and a hard blue sky. Light: warm light from the upper left. A strong red Fire hint. The sun is high and bright, lighting the two raised scars on his shoulders. Expression: ambitious, cruel, boastful.

people.imagined: On the parade ground at dusk, a dead woman's fan-tassel on his sleeve, a hard look at a junior.
people.subject: The moment: standing straight on a parade ground at dusk, he glares at a junior just out of frame. Face, most important: a small faded red silk fan-tassel sewn to the sleeve, hanging from his shoulder, plain; a hard, scarred, tanned, battle-worn face, grey in his short beard, deep lines, a straight cold mouth, pale hard eyes. His beard is cropped short and shot with grey, a long white scar crosses his left cheek, and his eyes are pale and wet from the wind. Hair: black going grey, short. Body: tall, broad, stern. He stands with his feet at shoulder width and his hands behind his back, a rigid and unbending figure. Clothing: a vermilion silk jacket cut for war, a dark red sash, leather breastplate; the hem edged with two narrow bands, gold and white. The leather breastplate is cracked and polished by use, a red cord is wound round his left wrist, and the faded red tassel hangs from the sleeve. Hands and objects: a red war fan held closed in the right hand. Background: A wide parade ground of packed earth with long shadows, a line of recruits in red tunics at attention, and a wall with a banner of plain red cloth. Light: low red dusk light from the upper left. A strong red Fire hint. The low red sun throws his shadow long across the ground. Expression: warlike, cruel, loyal.

people.imagined: At the flagship's helm, one ear tilted to every shout; list of pirate keels in a pouch.
people.subject: The moment: at a ship's wheel, he turns his notched ear to a shout and eyes the viewer. Face, most important: the left ear notched by a grapple, a deep, jagged V cut out of its rim, visible with the hair tied back; a weathered, calm, lined face, a salt-grey stubble, narrowed vigilant eyes. His eyes are narrow and creased from sun, his stubble is grey, and a small gold ring glints in the notched ear. Hair: black going grey, tied in a short tail. Body: lean, braced, sea-legged. He stands braced with his knees slightly bent, rolling with the deck, hands steady on the spokes. Clothing: a vermilion silk jacket cut short, a crossed collar, a dark red sash. A leather cord at his neck carries a small brass whistle, the cuffs of his jacket are stained with tar, and his boots are of oiled leather. Hands and objects: both hands on a big wooden wheel; a scroll of names tucked in the belt. Background: A ship's deck of pale planks, a coil of rope, a binnacle, a pair of sailors working the rigging in the distance, a red sail and a bright sea. Light: A bright clean light off the water shines on the brass of the wheel, from the upper left. Faint blue Water hint. Expression: calm, diligent, wary.

people.imagined: On the wall at night, her head tilted to the ridge, a thunder-charm in her ear; she is deciding whether this rumble is rain.
people.subject: The moment: on a wall at night, she tilts her left ear to the dark ridge, listening, deciding. Face, most important: a small bright thunder-charm of blue-black iron hanging from the left ear lobe, in sharp focus, catching the lamp; a calm, narrow, careful face, a straight nose, steady dark eyes, a closed mouth that hides a smile. Her eyebrows are fine and slightly arched, her lashes are short, and the thunder-charm swings against her cheek as she tilts her head. Hair: black, in a tight bun, a stray wisp. Body: slim, still. She stands very still with her head tilted and her weight even, her thin neck stretched in listening. Clothing: a vermilion silk jacket cut for watch, a crossed collar, dark red sash, short cloak. A short grey cloak is folded over her shoulders against the night chill, her gloves are fingerless, and her boots are quiet-soled. Hands and objects: a lantern hooded low in the right hand. Background: a blurred battlement and black ridge. A wide stone parapet with a row of crenellations, a dark rolling ridge on the horizon and, far off over it, a faint blue-white flicker in the clouds. Light: a lantern from the lower left and faint lightning far away. A red Fire hint. A small lantern casts a low orange glow while the sky is a deep blue-black. Expression: cautious, patient, a little deceitful.

people.imagined: In a village square at the end of a ceremony of thanks, with a granary cart behind him; every thank-you makes the blush climb his neck.
people.subject: The moment: standing by a granary cart in a village square, being thanked, he blushes and looks away. Face, most important: a deep blush climbing from the collar over the whole neck, ears and cheeks, bright red against a pale skin; a gentle, open, noble-born face, a long straight nose, soft brown eyes lowered, an embarrassed half smile. His eyebrows are fine and level, his lips are thin and slightly pressed in embarrassment, and a small beauty mark sits just under his left eye. Hair: black, in a neat knot. Body: tall, a little awkward, shoulders rounded. He stands stiffly with his shoulders hunched and his weight on his back foot, as though he would like to step out of the frame. Clothing: a vermilion silk robe, well fitted, a crossed collar, a dark red sash; the hem edged with two narrow bands, gold and white; a garland of flowers hung round his neck. Hands and objects: a sack of rice held awkwardly in both arms. Background: a blurred village square with bunting and children. Behind him a granary cart piled with sacks tied with red cord, a row of village elders in their best blue jackets bowing, and a banner of plain red cloth on two bamboo poles. Light: bright light from the upper left. Faint red Fire and green Wood hint. The bright noon light makes the garland's petals glow and shows every pink shade of his skin. Expression: generous, honest, mortified.

people.imagined: At the grinding stone, her part widened with red dust, watching a rival's batch. She pockets a measure and does not blink.
people.subject: The moment: at a grinding stone, she looks up from the pestle with a cool smile, a quick hand slipping something into her sleeve. Face, most important: cinnabar-red dust lying in the parting of her black hair, a bright red line down the middle of her head; a sharp, handsome, narrow face, a pointed chin, bright calculating dark eyes, a thin red-tinted mouth. A small dimple appears at the corner of her thin mouth, her eyelashes are long and dusted red, and a thin line of cinnabar powder has settled in the creases beside her nose. Hair: black, parted dead centre, in a bun. Body: slender, quick, upright. Clothing: a vermilion silk robe with sleeves tied back, a pale apron dusted red, a dark red sash. A pair of leather gloves is tucked into her sash, her apron is tied with a double bow, and the bottoms of her sleeves are red to the wrist; a small brass scale hangs at her belt. Hands and objects: a stone pestle in a mortar of bright red powder. On the table beside the mortar sit three tiny clay jars, one lid slightly ajar. Background: Behind her a long bench with a row of stone mortars and weights, a shelf of sealed jars, and the open mouth of a furnace with red glow in a smoky room. Light: The orange glow from the furnace catches the red dust in her hair and a little steam drifts across the light, from the lower right. A faint red Fire hint. Expression: ambitious, diligent, greedy.

people.imagined: At the New Year tribute counting, two tally-sticks behind his ears, scanning the carters for one who did not bow.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a counting table, he glances up suspiciously from a ledger, a tally stick behind each ear. Face, most important: two long pale tally-sticks tucked one behind each ear, sticking out sideways like whiskers, one notched in rows, one stained; a thin, dry, pinched face, a long nose, sharp, watchful eyes, a stern small mouth. His moustache is thin and neat, a small crease sits between his eyes, and his lips are narrow and dry. Hair: black, thin, scraped back. Body: thin, neat, upright. He sits bolt upright with his elbows tucked in, every inch of his bearing neat and exact. Clothing: a vermilion silk robe, plain and crisp, a crossed collar, sleeves tied back, a dark red sash. A pair of small round brass spectacle-frames without glass hang from a cord round his neck, a small bundle of keys is at his belt, and his sleeves are protected with black cloth guards. Hands and objects: an abacus before him; a pile of copper strings and rice samples. Background: a blurred hall with stacks of tribute. Behind him sacks of grain and rolls of cloth are stacked by weight, six small flags of different colours stand on a stand for the vassals, and a wooden door is closed with a bar. Light: grey light from the upper left. A faint red Fire hint. The grey light from a high window falls flat on the ledger. Expression: arbitrary, paranoid, diligent.

people.imagined: At the vent's lip after a breakthrough, he looks at the sky before he speaks. It is cloudy, so he says nothing.
people.subject: The moment: at the lip of a vent with a long broom, he tilts his face to the sky and waits, then closes his mouth. Face, most important: head tilted back, eyes on a grey sky, mouth shut after being about to speak; a calm, long, lean face, a hollow cheek, a mild pale-brown gaze, soot on the brow. There are lines of soot in the creases of his eyelids, his lips are dry and chapped, and he has a long solemn jaw. Hair: black, in a knot with a cloth. A little grey ash dusts his hair like early snow. Body: tall, thin, stooped. He stands with his broom held upright like a staff and his head high, a patient scarecrow of a man. Clothing: a vermilion tunic, scorched at the hem, a dark red sash; leather boots. A grey cloth is tied across his nose and mouth and pulled down to his chin for speaking, his gloves are of thick leather, and the hem of the tunic is singed. Hands and objects: a long broom and a small iron shovel of coals. Background: a blurred vent lip with a red glow and a grey sky. A wide platform of black rock with deep cracks, a stone seat in the middle, a plume of heat shimmer above the vent, and a high pale sky with heavy cloud. Light: dull grey light from the upper left, orange from below. A faint red Fire hint. The grey sky gives flat light while an orange glow rises from the cracks below. Expression: patient, reclusive, silent.

people.imagined: At the door of the audience hall, bribes in his sleeve, cuff thread glittering; he decides today's order with a polite smile.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a doorway holding a roll, he bows slightly with a smooth smile, gold thread glinting at his cuff. Face, most important: bright gold embroidery thread at the cuff of the right sleeve, a glittering band, held up as he gestures; a smooth, comfortable, fleshy face, a short soft beard, bright shrewd small eyes, a generous mouth. A fine web of lines crosses his brow, his small mouth is soft and smiling, and his cheeks have a rosy glow from good wine. Hair: grey, oiled, in a neat knot with a gold pin. A little grey shows at the temples under the gold pin. Body: stout, dignified. He stands with a slight bow and one foot forward, his stout belly neat under the sash, a very practised courtesy. Clothing: a vermilion silk robe, sumptuous, a crossed collar, a dark red sash; the hem edged with two narrow bands, gold and green. A thick purse hangs at his waist with a gold tassel, a heavy ring set with a red stone shines on his right hand, and his slippers are of red silk. Hands and objects: a short scroll in the left hand; one hand tucked into a heavy sleeve. Background: A tall carved doorway with red pillars, a line of petitioners in the courtyard behind him, a servant holding a tray of gifts, and a bronze incense burner with a thread of smoke. Light: Warm light streams into the doorway and makes the gold thread at his cuff glitter, from the upper left. A faint red Fire hint. Expression: arbitrary, deceitful, generous.

people.imagined: In the flute stall, hearing a note in her head before she answers; a flute in her hands, head slightly tilted.
people.subject: The moment: holding a flute under her chin, she hums a note silently, eyes far away, then smiles at the viewer. Face, most important: eyes unfocused and lips shaped around an unvoiced note, head tilted; a warm, round, honest face, rosy cheeks, soft arched brows, a trusting smile. Her cheeks are rosy and round, her nose is small and straight, and a tiny dimple sits beside her mouth. Hair: black, in a low knot with a jade pin. Body: medium, gentle. She holds the flute at her chin with elbows level and shoulders relaxed, her head slightly tilted as if listening for the note in her head. Clothing: a vermilion silk robe with long sleeves, a dark red sash. A small jade pendant shaped like a flute hangs from a green cord round her neck, a cloth bag of reeds hangs at her waist, and the long sleeves are tied back with a strip of silk. Hands and objects: a pale-green jade-coloured bamboo flute in both hands. Background: A narrow market stall hung with dozens of flutes of different lengths in rows, labelled with dabs of coloured paint, a lantern, and a street of other stalls beyond with a crowd. Light: soft light from the upper left. Faint green Wood hint. The warm light of the afternoon glows on the pale bamboo. Expression: gregarious, trusting, honest.

people.imagined: Knitting a bracelet of chrysanthemum fluff and holding it out to the viewer to take, a soft grandmotherly smile.
people.subject: The moment: holding out a small woven bracelet of yellow fluff in an open palm, offering it with a gentle smile. Face, most important: a bracelet of soft golden-yellow chrysanthemum fluff held out on her palm, fluffy and bright; a kind, round, freckled face, soft cheeks, warm brown eyes, a patient smile; loose down in her hair. Her cheeks are soft and freckled, her lashes are pale, and a tiny pale tuft of fluff clings to her chin. Hair: black, in a bun, flecked with down. Body: plump, soft. She sits with her shoulders rounded and her hands in her lap, a soft, stooped, patient figure. Clothing: a vermilion robe with a crossed collar, sleeves tied back, a dark red sash; a pouch of down at her belt. A coral bead on a cord hangs round her wrist and a knitted yellow shawl lies over her shoulders; her apron pocket holds balls of fluff in many shades. Hands and objects: the bracelet, a ball of fluff. Background: A small shed with shelves of pale sacks, a window with a view of a field of yellow chrysanthemums, a basket of bright feathers on the floor and soft down floating in the air. Light: warm light from the upper left. A faint red Fire hint. Soft light through the window makes the floating down glitter. Expression: compassionate, patient, loyal.

people.imagined: On the western march with a hawk on his glove, spyglass through his belt like a dagger, looking out at a rising seat on a far peak.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a cliff edge with a hawk on his gloved fist, a spyglass thrust through his belt like a dagger, he looks to the far distance. Face, most important: a brass spyglass thrust through his belt, hilt-like, bright; a lean, windburnt face, a hooked nose, narrowed grey eyes, a stubborn jaw, a thin line of beard. A day's stubble darkens his jaw, his eyes are narrow and ringed by sun lines, and a small old scar notches his chin. Hair: black, wild, in a tail. Body: wiry, standing at ease. He stands with his feet wide apart and his body leaning slightly into the wind, the stance of a man who watches far horizons. Clothing: a vermilion jacket for travel with a crossed collar, a leather vest, a dark red sash; a leather glove. A heavy leather glove covers his left hand to the elbow, a small whistle hangs at his throat, and his cloak is pinned at the shoulder with a bronze clasp. Hands and objects: a brown hawk on the left fist. Background: a blurred cliff and far peak in mist. A bare jagged cliff edge in the foreground, a chasm full of cloud below, and on the far horizon a thin grey spire rising from a new peak, with a pair of hawks circling. Light: cold bright light from the upper left. Faint grey Metal hint. The cold clear light shows every grain of the rock and every line of his face. Expression: cautious, stubborn, watchful.

people.imagined: Whistling the birds down with a whistle curled in her cheek, so that when she speaks she lisps; sparrows landing on her arm.
people.subject: The moment: whistling, with a small wooden whistle curled in one cheek, she looks at the viewer, birds landing on her outstretched arm. Face, most important: one cheek puffed out round a small bone whistle held inside it, visible as a bulge; a round, merry, freckled face, a button nose, bright dark eyes. Her cheeks are rosy and freckled with a dimple on one side, and her lips are slightly pursed round the whistle. Hair: black, in two braids. Body: slight, springy. She stands with one arm lifted and her shoulders squared, perfectly balanced, as light and quick as a bird herself. Clothing: an undyed hemp tunic with a red cord at the waist, sleeves rolled. A necklace of small coloured feathers hangs at her throat, a pouch of seed is tied at her waist, and her sleeve is spotted with white droppings. Hands and objects: three small brown sparrows perched on the outstretched arm. Background: a blurred aviary. A tall aviary of wire and dark wood behind her, many small birds on perches, a sack of seed on a stool, and a blue sky overhead showing through the roof lattice. Light: bright light from the upper left. Faint green Wood hint. Bright sun glints on the little wings and the feathers in her hair. Expression: gregarious, compassionate, fickle.

people.imagined: Cutting shoots in the grove, sleeve rolled to show eight scorch-lines; he tells the tree it needs Wood more than the palace needs Fire.
people.subject: The moment: cutting a bamboo shoot, he lifts his forearm with a content smile, eight scorch-lines visible. Face, most important: eight short parallel scorch-lines, burnt brown, in a neat row across the left forearm; a calm, plain, pleasant face, a wide nose, sleepy-clever eyes, a half smile. His brows are thick and level, a streak of green sap runs along his cheek, and his smile is lopsided with one dimple. Hair: black, in a short tail. Body: lean, bending. He stands with his weight on one leg, easygoing, shoulders loose, the stance of a man who knows how to wait. Clothing: undyed hemp tunic with a red cord, sleeves rolled. A basket sling crosses his chest, a small hemp bag of tools hangs at his belt, and his trousers are tucked into boots wet from the grove. Hands and objects: a short curved knife; a basket of pale shoots. Background: a blurred bamboo grove. A grove of tall green bamboo with shoots poking from the ground in clusters, a path of beaten earth with a wheelbarrow, and a stone shrine to a bamboo spirit half hidden in the culms. Light: soft green light from the upper left. Faint green Wood hint. A cool green light fills the grove and makes the pale shoots glow. Expression: content, pragmatic, sly.

people.imagined: At dawn with his eyes shut blowing the second flute part, half a beat behind on purpose.
people.subject: The moment: playing a flute at dawn with eyes closed, cheeks round. Face, most important: eyes shut tight and cheeks puffed, a flute at his lips; a calm, broad face, a stubborn jaw, a faint serenity. His brows are thick and level and relaxed, his lips are full and pursed round the mouthpiece, and a calm line of sweat shines at his temple. Hair: black, in a topknot. Body: sturdy, straight. He stands with his feet planted and his chest wide to take breath, shoulders low, an unmoving figure of calm. Clothing: an undyed hemp robe tied with a red cord, clean. A green cord ties his sleeves back, a small cloth case for the flute hangs from his sash, and the hem of his robe is dewy from the grass. Hands and objects: a long bamboo flute. Background: a blurred courtyard in dawn. A stone courtyard in the first light, a row of other players standing in a line, the red-lacquered pillar of a gate, and the dark shape of the great wutong's boughs against the sky. Light: pink light from the upper left. Faint green Wood hint. A pink and gold sunrise glows behind him and outlines his shoulders. Expression: calm, stubborn, content.

people.imagined: On the long road with urns on his back, asking each its name; the stoppers at his throat click as he nods.
people.subject: The moment: walking a road, he nods gravely to the viewer, a string of small stoppers clicking at his throat. Face, most important: a string of small round ceramic stoppers hung at his throat like a necklace, pale and numerous; a long, gentle, worn face, kind deep eyes, thin lips, grey in the stubble. His brows are grey and drooping, his lips are thin and dry, and his cheeks are hollow with long walking. Hair: black and grey, in a knot. Body: thin, bent under a load. He walks with his head bowed and his shoulders drawn forward by the heavy load, a slow and patient stride. Clothing: an undyed hemp robe with a red cord, dust at the hem. Strips of white cloth are wound round his hands against the rope, his sandals are bound with straw, and a small red feather is stuck in his hair. Hands and objects: a staff; urns on a frame at his back. Background: a blurred road to a ridge. A long dusty road climbs behind him through dry grass to a distant ridge of dark trees, a stone milestone, and a low sun. Light: soft light from the upper left. Faint grey Metal hint. The warm low light makes the little stoppers shine like pearls. Expression: devout, patient, humble.

people.imagined: In the kitchen yard at New Year setting out ninety bowls; he walks with the stoop of a yoke he put down years ago.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a kitchen yard with a stack of bowls, still stooped as if under a yoke, smiling broadly. Face, most important: a stoop of the shoulders held as though carrying a yoke that is not there, shoulders rounded and one higher than the other; a round, brown, cheerful, wrinkled face, a toothy grin, bright small eyes. His few teeth are strong and yellow, his eyes are a warm hazel, and the deep lines on his face turn up as he laughs. Hair: white, short. His short white hair is cropped like a bristly brush. Body: thick, bent. His shoulders are rounded and his neck thrust forward, and his arms are thick and sinewy from years of carrying. Clothing: a plain undyed hemp servant's tunic, clean, an apron. A strip of cloth is tied round his forehead, his apron is wet at the front, and his sleeves are rolled to the elbow showing a brown, hairy forearm. Hands and objects: a tall stack of ninety small bowls in his arms. Background: A wide kitchen yard with a great well and a stack of wooden buckets, long tables set with ninety bowls in neat rows, steam from a big cauldron, and a gaggle of hens at the gate. Light: Warm morning light and white steam fill the yard, from the upper left. Faint ochre hint. Expression: generous, gregarious, loyal.

people.imagined: In the guard room when someone names the Feather Kindling; she goes grey and silent and turns to the door.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a guard room, her face has gone grey and she is half turned toward the door, a hand on her sword. Face, most important: skin gone grey-white as ash, drained, with lips pressed, a clear contrast with the red of her collar; a square, strong, miner's-daughter face, thick brows, dark eyes fixed on the floor. Her lips are pale and pressed thin, a bead of cold sweat stands at her hairline, and her eyes are fixed on the floor. Hair: black, cropped, under a cloth. Body: sturdy, tense. She stands half turned with one shoulder toward the door and her free arm held rigid, the whole body tense to leave. Clothing: a vermilion guard's jacket of plain cut, a crossed collar, a dark sash. A leather strap crosses her chest holding a scabbard, her sleeves are tied back with cord, and a miner's small lamp is pinned to her collar as a keepsake. Hands and objects: a plain steel sword gripped at the hip. Background: a blurred guardroom with racks. A small guardroom with a rack of swords and a table with a half-eaten meal, a lamp, a door standing open to a bright corridor, and a pair of guards staring. Light: grey light from the upper left. Faint grey Metal hint. The grey light from the door leaves her face a pale mask. Expression: brave, stubborn, shut down.

people.imagined: Rolling her sleeves to hide the worn cuff under a too-bright tassel, claiming a sitting she did not pass.
people.subject: The moment: rolling a sleeve back so a bright tassel hides the cuff, smiling confidently at the viewer. Face, most important: an oversized, over-bright orange silk tassel hanging from the rolled cuff, gaudy against the plain vermilion; a pretty, sharp, impatient face, bright eyes, a quick smile, a flush. Her eyebrows are fine and sharply arched, her lashes are long, and her lips are bright with a touch of red paint. Hair: black, in a high knot with red ribbons. Body: slim, quick. She stands with one hip cocked and her chin up, the sleeves rolled with a flourish, a posture that wants to be admired. Clothing: a vermilion silk robe, the cuff slightly creased under the too-bright tassel, a dark red sash. A string of tiny bells hangs from her sash, the vermilion silk is faded at the elbows, and she wears bright red ribbons on her wrists. Hands and objects: a red fan open in the right hand. Background: A courtyard of raked sand with a row of fan racks behind her, two other inner disciples whispering at the edge, and a tiled roof against a bright sky. Light: warm light from the upper left. A strong red Fire hint. The sun flashes on the over-bright tassel. Expression: ambitious, impatient, deceitful.

people.imagined: In the courtyard just after being given an order, mouth half open to deliver it word for word.
people.subject: The moment: running in a courtyard, he has stopped with his mouth half open, ready to speak the next word. Face, most important: mouth half open and expectant, bright and eager; a round, open, honest face, bright wide eyes, a snub nose. His eyes are wide and round, his eyebrows are high, and his lips are slightly parted showing a gap between two teeth. Hair: black, tousled. Body: slim, springy, mid-step. He stands up on the balls of his feet, mid-stride, with his head forward and his shoulders square, a figure full of eagerness. Clothing: a vermilion tunic, a dark red sash. A small leather message tube hangs from a strap across his chest, his sleeves are rolled back to free his arms, and his boots are splashed with mud. Hands and objects: a folded paper in the right hand. A tiny dab of ink stains the side of his thumb, and the paper he carries is folded exactly in thirds, held as if it might break. Background: A long courtyard of grey flagstones with red pillars on each side, a figure in a doorway waiting with a hand raised, and a bright sky. Light: bright light from the upper left. A faint red Fire hint. Clear light shows every freckle on his round face. Expression: honest, trusting, eager.

people.imagined: New at the outer court, two burnt feather-ends tied in her hair as charms, wide-eyed.
people.subject: The moment: standing wide-eyed in a courtyard, showing two singed feathers in her hair. Face, most important: two blackened, burnt feather ends tied into her hair on each side, short and singed; a small, round, bright, trusting face, a button nose. Her eyes are very bright and round, a few pale freckles cross her nose, and her cheeks are flushed pink with excitement. Her front teeth are slightly crooked, and she bites her lower lip in excitement. Hair: black, in two braids. Body: small, thin. She stands on her toes with her hands clenched in front of her, small and tense and thrilled. Clothing: undyed hemp tunic, red cord at the waist, clean. A bundle of red-stained feathers is tied to her belt, her sleeves are too long and flop over her hands, and her sandals are new. Hands and objects: a fresh white feather held in a fist. Background: a blurred courtyard. A broad courtyard with older disciples in red robes practising in rows, a tall stone gate with a red lantern, and a pale morning sky. Light: bright light from the upper left. Faint red Fire hint. Bright light glints on the feathers in her hair and the freshly oiled braids. Expression: trusting, impatient, eager.

people.imagined: At the table in a village, straw in his hair, tired and happy beside the cart.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a table, straw sticking from his hair, he beams at the viewer. Face, most important: bits of golden straw sticking in all directions from his black hair; a broad, tanned, simple face, a wide grin, warm eyes. His cheeks are round and red, his nose is broad, and his eyes are warm and slightly sleepy. Hair: black, with straw. A bright wisp of straw sticks up from his crown like a feather. Body: strong, loose. He sits with his elbows on the table and his shoulders relaxed, a big gentle body at ease after work. Clothing: undyed hemp tunic tied with a red cord. A bag of rice samples hangs from his belt, his sleeves are cuffed with brown cloth, and his boots are by the table with straw sticking out. Hands and objects: a bowl of rice. His forearms are brown from the sun and his thumbs are cracked from threshing; he smells, plainly, of rice and warm straw. Background: A long wooden table in a village inn with bowls of rice and bean paste, a lamp, a sleeping dog, and through the open door a cart under a tree. Light: The warm evening light turns the straw to gold, from the upper left. Faint ochre hint. Expression: diligent, content, generous.

people.imagined: Licking her pen as she copies a petition, and adding her name to the best one; a blue stain on her lips.
people.subject: The moment: at a desk, she touches the tip of her brush to her lips, then glances up. Face, most important: lips stained ink-blue, clear against a pale face; a neat, narrow face, a sharp nose, bright ambitious eyes. Her lashes are long and her eyebrows are thin, a small beauty mark sits above her lip, and her cheeks are slightly hollow. Hair: black, in a bun with a bamboo pin. Body: slim, bent over the desk. She sits with her back very straight and her head bowed, the sleeves pushed up neatly over her elbows. Clothing: an undyed hemp robe with a red cord, sleeves tied back. A bamboo-green ribbon ties her hair, her sash is tied with a neat bow, and her cuffs are protected with black sleeve guards. Hands and objects: a brush; a stack of petitions. Background: a blurred hall. A long desk heaped with petitions tied in bundles, a lamp, a brush stand, an open window with a courtyard, and behind her an older clerk working with his head down. Light: a lamp from the upper left. Faint red Fire hint. The lamp casts a warm circle that shows the stain on her lips. Expression: diligent, deceitful, ambitious.

people.imagined: Walking on the quay with a rolling gait, pay spent, grinning, being dragged back aboard.
people.subject: The moment: walking along a quay with a rolling sailor's swagger, he grins at the viewer. Face, most important: a broad grin with a gold coin-sized earring; a sunburnt, handsome, rough face, dark eyes, a stubble; the body leans to one side as if the ground rocked. His brows are thick and black, his jaw is square and stubbled, and a fine scar cuts through one eyebrow. Hair: black, in a tail with a red rag. Body: lean, rolling. He walks with his feet wide apart and his arms swinging, the whole body rolling in rhythm. Clothing: a vermilion sleeveless jacket, a hemp tunic, a dark red sash. A string of brass coins hangs at his hip, his jacket is unlaced to show a brown chest, and a tattoo of a small wave marks his forearm. Hands and objects: a rope coiled over the shoulder. Background: a blurred harbour. A wooden quay with stacked crates and barrels, a tavern with a lantern, a row of ships with tall masts, and a sky with scattered pink clouds. Light: bright light from the upper left. Faint blue Water hint. The golden light of late afternoon glints on the gold earring. Expression: brave, indulgent, gregarious.

people.imagined: Surfacing from a dive, a tiny bell pendant clenched in her teeth, calm, breath held longer than the man who resents her.
people.subject: The moment: surfacing from the sea, water streaming, she holds a small dark bronze bell pendant clamped in her teeth and looks calmly at the viewer. Face, most important: a small green-bronze bell with a cord clamped between her bared front teeth, hanging at the chin, bright wet metal; a smooth, narrow, brown face, long wet lashes, calm dark eyes, water running down. Her lips are pale from the cold and stretched tight round the bell, a few drops of water bead on her eyelashes, and her cheeks are flushed from the effort. Hair: black, plastered to her skull, one long wet braid over a shoulder. A loose strand of wet hair sticks across her forehead. Body: lean, sleek, shoulders bare to the collarbone. Clothing: a short vermilion sleeveless diving jacket, soaked dark, over a pale hemp undershirt, a red cord at the waist. Hands and objects: one hand gripping the rail of a boat; the other holding a net bag. Background: a blurred sea and the side of a ship. The wooden side of a boat in the lower corner, a rope ladder hanging in the water, a patch of green-grey swell, and in the distance a low line of dark jungle coast. Light: bright cool light from the upper left. Faint blue Water hint. A clear cold sunlight glitters on the water and the green of the bell. Expression: brave, calm, reclusive.

people.imagined: At the oar bench in the sun, chin held high though his palms are raw; he has just had a deck hand lashed and laughs.
people.subject: The moment: seated on a rowing bench among the deck hands, he looks down at the viewer from a great height. Face, most important: a chin lifted so high that the nostrils show, a haughty tilt, and the palms below it red and blistered; a handsome, proud, narrow young face, a long straight nose, light cold eyes, a curl of mouth. His eyebrows are fine and straight, his cheeks are smooth, and a long lock of hair has come loose and hangs over one eye. Hair: black, in a neat knot with a jade pin. Body: tall, straight, a little thin. He sits upright on the bench with his shoulders back and his spine stiff, bearing the pain like a prince. Clothing: a vermilion silk jacket, fine and clean though sleeves are rolled, a dark red sash; the hem edged with a gold band. A jade pendant hangs from his neck, his sash is of fine silk embroidered with small waves, and his boots are of soft leather. Hands and objects: both raw palms gripping the shaft of a long wooden oar. Background: a long row of oar benches with other deck hands bent to their oars, a taut sail, a drum and drummer in the stern, and a green-grey sea. Light: bright light from the upper left. Faint blue Water hint. Strong sun makes the sweat on his brow gleam and shows the red of his palms. Expression: arrogant, cruel, proud.

people.imagined: On the vein fort wall at night, one hand pressed to the stone as if listening to it; he longs to see an enemy sword.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a wall at night with one palm flat on the stone, he looks out at the dark and then at the viewer. Face, most important: skin the dull grey of rock, with a rock-dust pallor across his face, hands and neck; a square, hard, heavy face, a broken nose, small dark eyes, a stubborn jaw. His eyes are small and dark with a hard glitter, his lips are thick and dry, and a fine rock-dust lies in the creases of his brow. Hair: black, cropped, dusty. Body: thick, solid, a wall of a man. He stands with his legs set wide and his shoulders square, patient as a stone in the wall. Clothing: an undyed hemp jacket with a red cord, leather bracers, a sword at the hip. A strap of leather holds a small lamp at his shoulder, his trousers are dark and fitted, and his boots are heavy and studded. Hands and objects: the right palm against the wall; a short plain sword. Background: A long wall of rough-hewn red-brown stone with a walkway, a signal fire basket on a pole, and the faint line of a pass under a starry sky. Light: Cold moonlight gives his grey skin an almost blue cast, from the upper left. Faint grey Metal and red Fire hint. Expression: warlike, loyal, stubborn.

people.imagined: On the fort roof with two signal banners, one hand stained red and one black; she reads a banner across the vein and hopes it does not mean war.
people.subject: The moment: holding a red banner in one hand and a black banner in the other, she looks across a gap, wishing for peace. Face, most important: the fingertips of her right hand dyed bright red and the left hand dyed black, clearly two colours, both held up; a gentle, round, thoughtful face, calm dark eyes, soft brows, a pale complexion. Her eyebrows are thin and straight, her cheeks are a little hollow, and a faint smear of red dye stains her chin. Hair: black, in a neat double bun. Body: slender. She stands with her feet together and her arms lifted, very straight, shoulders level, patient as a heron. Clothing: an undyed hemp tunic with a red cord, sleeves rolled. A cloth apron stained with red and black dye splashes is tied over her tunic, her sleeves are tied back, and a pouch of dyes hangs from her sash. Hands and objects: two small plain cloth signal flags, red and black, on short poles, no writing. Background: The flat roof of a watchtower with a rail of wood, a rack of poles with rolled cloth, a drum, and a far view of two ridges with a pale river of mist between them. Light: A bright clean light on the flags brings out the red and the black, from the upper left. Faint red Fire hint. Expression: peaceable, honest, cautious.

people.imagined: Sorting dried herbs; her nose wrinkles at every smell, even good ones; she knows the fevers by scent.
people.subject: The moment: holding a bundle of dried herbs under her nose, she wrinkles her nose hard. Face, most important: nose scrunched up in a deep wrinkle, nostrils flared, eyes squeezed half-shut; a small, kind, freckled face, a wide mouth. Her cheeks are freckled and rosy, her eyes are small and bright, and her lips are slightly parted as she sniffs. Hair: black, in a bun under a cloth, herb sprigs stuck in it. Body: small, plump, in an apron. She stands slightly hunched with her shoulders raised, bending toward the bundle in her hands. Clothing: an undyed hemp tunic with a red cord, sleeves rolled, a green apron. A basket of herbs hangs from her back, a string of dried peppers is round her neck, and her hands are stained green to the wrist. Hands and objects: a dried bundle in each hand. Background: blurred racks of hanging herbs. A long shed with racks of drying herbs hung in rows, a table with a scale and small stone mortars, and a doorway showing a field of green rice. Light: warm light from the upper left. Faint green Wood hint. Warm golden light falls through the shed slats. Expression: compassionate, diligent, humble.

people.imagined: In the granary, knocking on a bin and listening, knuckles to wood, head cocked.
people.subject: The moment: knocking on a wooden grain bin with a knuckle, ear cocked, listening. Face, most important: one knuckle raised and rapping a wooden bin, his head tilted to it; a patient, broad, weathered face, grey stubble, closed eyes, a faint smile. His brows are bushy and grey, deep lines frame his closed eyes, and his lips are folded over missing teeth. Hair: grey-black, tied in a rag. A few grey hairs stick out under the rag. Body: sturdy, bent. He leans forward with one hand flat on the bin and his shoulders bent, a long-practised stoop. Clothing: a plain undyed hemp servant's tunic, dusty with grain, a cloth at the neck. A leather apron stiff with grain-dust covers his tunic, a small wooden measure hangs from his belt, and his feet are in straw shoes. Hands and objects: a wooden shovel against his shoulder. Background: a blurred granary bin. Long wooden bins in a row fill the dim granary, each marked with a daub of paint, a ladder, a small window, and a cat asleep on a sack. Light: dusty light from the upper left. Faint ochre Earth hint. A bar of dusty gold light from a window falls across his face. Expression: patient, content, honest.

people.imagined: Tuning a qin by the dawn flute, her fingertips grooved by the strings.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a qin, plucking one string with her head bowed, then looking up. Face, most important: deep straight grooves, one per string, across the pads of her raised fingertips, clearly visible in a row of seven; a calm, pale, delicate face, a straight nose, still dark eyes. Her brows are fine and straight, her lashes long, and her lips are pale and still. Hair: black, in a smooth low bun. Body: slim, upright, seated. She sits very straight with her shoulders soft and her head slightly bowed, as though hearing the instrument. Clothing: an undyed hemp robe with a red cord, sleeves tied back. A white cord ties her sleeves, a small tuning key hangs from a cord at her neck, and a short grey apron covers her robe. Hands and objects: a dark lacquered qin on a table, silk strings catching the light. Background: a blurred shop. A luthier's shop with a row of qin of various sizes on racks, coils of silk thread, a bench with tools, and a screen painted with bamboo. Light: soft light from the upper left. Faint grey Metal hint. Soft grey light from a paper window falls across the strings. Expression: calm, diligent, reclusive.

people.imagined: Behind the counter in the shop, playing a stock flute while the owner is out; reeds behind each ear, half asleep.
people.subject: The moment: leaning on a counter, he plays a flute lazily, eyes half closed. Face, most important: a thin bamboo reed tucked behind each ear, sticking up like antennae; a young, loose, sleepy face, a lopsided grin. His brows are thin and uneven, his cheeks are smooth, and his lips are a little too wide. Hair: black, spiky. Body: lanky, slouched. He slouches with his elbows on the counter and his legs crossed, loose and boneless. Clothing: an undyed hemp tunic with a red cord, rumpled. A string of copper coins hangs at his belt, his tunic is crooked and his sleeves are stained with oil, and he wears one sandal and holds the other. Hands and objects: a flute at his lips. Background: a blurred shop of flutes. A narrow shop crowded with flutes and reed organs in rows, a counter with a cash box, a sleeping cat, and a door open to a busy lane. A rack of reed pipes in graduated sizes hangs behind him, and a card of faded paper flowers is pinned beside the shelf. Light: warm light from the upper left. Faint grey Metal hint. A warm light from the door glows on the flute. Expression: fickle, gregarious, lazy.

people.imagined: At night before the furnace, watching for the colour change, eyelids red from glare.
people.subject: The moment: sitting before a furnace's glow at night, watching the fire without blinking. Face, most important: reddened, swollen eyelids glowing, red-rimmed from furnace glare; a calm, thin, young face lit orange, steady attentive eyes. His eyebrows are singed short, his cheeks are lean, and his lips are chapped. Hair: black, tied in a cloth. Body: slim, sitting cross-legged. He sits with his back straight and his hands on his knees, perfectly still, as if carved. Clothing: an undyed hemp tunic with a red cord, sooted. A wet cloth is tied round his neck, his sleeves are rolled up, and his tunic is spotted with burn holes. Hands and objects: a long iron poker across the knees. A small clay cup of cold tea sits beside his knee, and a bundle of spare charcoal sticks lies at his other side. The red light makes his skin the colour of copper, and a faint tremor of heat ripples the air between him and the lens. Background: A great bronze furnace with a mouth of red coals and a chimney going up into darkness, a stack of charcoal, and a water barrel with a dipper. Light: The furnace glow lights only the front of his face; the rest is shadow, from the front. A strong red Fire hint. Expression: patient, diligent, calm.

people.imagined: Climbing to the furnace with a basket of cassia bark, smiling, trusting everyone.
people.subject: The moment: carrying a basket of cassia bark up a path, smiling shyly at the viewer. Face, most important: a basket of curled brown cassia bark piled high on her back, scrolls of bark; a round, rosy, open face, big shy eyes, a small smile. Her brows are thin and arched, her lips are full, and her eyes are large and trusting. Hair: black, in two plaits with green cord. Body: small, sturdy. She leans forward under the weight of the basket, her back bent and her steps small and careful. Clothing: an undyed hemp tunic with a red cord, sleeves rolled. A sash of faded green cloth ties her waist, a small pouch of cassia sticks hangs at her hip, and her sandals are tied with grass. Hands and objects: the basket's straps in both hands. A few curled strips of bark have fallen from the basket on to the path behind her. Background: a blurred path. A steep path of red earth with stone steps climbing to a distant smoking chimney, cassia trees along it, and a wide sky of pale cloud. Light: soft light from the upper left. Faint green Wood hint. The warm light brings out the reddish brown of the bark. Expression: trusting, humble, content.

people.imagined: At the Ash Seat with the bell at her wrist, silenced by a cloth pinched around the clapper.
people.subject: The moment: standing at the vent lip with her wrist raised, a bell silenced by a pinch of cloth, her head bowed. Face, most important: a bronze bell at the wrist with a small wad of cloth pinched in its mouth, held at the front; a calm, devout, round face, lowered lids, a soft mouth. Her brows are straight and calm, her skin is clear and pale, and her eyelids are lowered in reverence. Hair: black, in a low knot. Body: slim, upright. She stands very still with her shoulders level and her wrist raised, a figure of ritual stillness. Clothing: a vermilion silk robe, plain and clean, a crossed collar, a dark red sash. A thin red cord hangs round her neck with a small bronze charm, her sleeves are long and wide, and her sandals are plain. Hands and objects: the silenced bell. Background: a blurred orange glow from the vent. A black stone ledge at the lip of a great vent, a bronze tripod censer with smoke, a second bell hanging on a post, and a dim red glow filling a cavern. Light: orange glow from below, cool grey from above. A faint red Fire hint. The red glow rises from below and gives her face a warm tint. Expression: devout, calm, loyal.

people.imagined: In the kitchen, showing a ladle burn up the back of her hand like a medal and seating guests by whim.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a pot with a ladle, holding up the back of her hand to show a long burn proudly. Face, most important: a long shiny pink ladle burn running up the back of her hand and wrist, held up like a medal; a round, red, jolly face, grey hairs, a loud grin, bright eyes. Her eyebrows are bushy and grey, her chin has a small mole, and she has a gap between her front teeth. Hair: grey, in a bun with a rag. Body: stout, strong. She stands with her feet planted and her free hand on her hip, a broad, solid, unmoving shape. Clothing: a plain undyed hemp servant's tunic with a white apron. A string of garlic hangs from her apron strings, her sleeves are rolled to the elbow showing thick forearms, and her slippers are flat and worn. Hands and objects: an iron ladle; a steaming pot. Background: a blurred kitchen. A long kitchen with a row of iron pots on a brick stove, a string of dried fish on the wall, a table covered with bowls, and a young kitchen boy hiding behind the door. Light: warm light from the upper left. Faint ochre Earth hint. The firelight and steam give the whole scene a golden haze. Expression: generous, arbitrary, boastful.

people.imagined: Looking around to see who is watching before smiling, a letter to write tonight.
people.subject: The moment: glancing sidelong over his shoulder before smiling a beat late at the viewer. Face, most important: a smile that comes a beat late, after the eyes have swept left and right; a handsome, friendly, open face, wide mouth, quick dark eyes. His eyebrows are thick and straight, his nose is broad, and his lips are full. Hair: black, in a tail. Body: broad, easy. He stands with one foot turned slightly toward the door and his shoulders loose, a relaxed stance that is not quite relaxed. Clothing: an undyed hemp tunic with a red cord, a clan-red band at the wrist. A red cord is wound round his wrist, his tunic is clean and new, and a small clan emblem is stitched at the collar. Hands and objects: a folded letter half hidden in his sleeve. His shoulders are a little too stiff for the easy smile, and the knuckles of the hand in his sleeve are white around the folded paper. Background: A stone courtyard with a well, a row of practising disciples, a closed door, and at the edge of the frame the dark shape of a man in a grey cloak. Light: The light of the warm afternoon casts a sharp shadow, from the upper left. A faint red Fire hint. Expression: generous, deceitful, watchful.

people.imagined: In the bamboo court with her silver hair tied in a bamboo ring, patient with her master.
people.subject: The moment: standing with a bamboo ring holding her hair, smiling patiently. Face, most important: silver-fine, white-grey hair at only twenty-six, long and shining, tied in a ring of bamboo; a young, gentle face, smooth cheeks, kind brown eyes. Her eyebrows are also pale, her eyes are a soft grey-brown, and her lips are thin and calm. Hair: silver-white, gathered in a bamboo ring at the nape. Body: slim, upright. She stands in a relaxed and respectful posture with her hands folded in front of her. Clothing: an undyed hemp robe with a green cord. A bamboo-green cord ties her waist, her sleeves are tied back with cord, and a small herb pouch hangs at her hip. Hands and objects: a small pot of herbs. Beside her on the wall a small pot holds a young herb with three pale-green leaves, and a bamboo watering ladle rests across it. Background: a blurred bamboo grove. A bamboo courtyard with rows of herb pots on a low wall, a stone bench, a tall clump of green culms, and an old man's figure in the distance. Light: soft light from the upper left. Faint green Wood hint. The silver of her hair catches the soft light of the morning. Expression: patient, humble, diligent.

people.imagined: At the spring fair, whistling through the gap between her front teeth, a flute-maker's ear turning.
people.subject: The moment: whistling a clear note through a gap in her front teeth, grinning at the viewer. Face, most important: a clear gap between the two front teeth shown in an open grin; a round, bright, freckled face, brown eyes, a snub nose. Her eyebrows are thick and her eyes are bright and slightly squinting with delight. A small pink flush sits high on her cheeks and her brown eyes shine; a tiny silver stud pierces her left ear. Hair: black, in two buns. The two buns are tied with red thread and a little tassel bobs from each. Body: small, springy. She stands with her shoulders back and her chin raised, light on her feet. Clothing: an undyed hemp tunic with a red cord. A small silk lantern-charm hangs round her neck, her sleeves are rolled, and her hem is hitched up on one side. Hands and objects: a paper lantern. A small bamboo whistle on a thread dangles from her fingers, and a ribbon of red paper flutters from her sleeve. Background: a blurred fair. A spring fair with stalls and strings of paper lanterns, a crowd of villagers, a flute-seller's booth, and a bright blue sky. Light: bright light from the upper left. Faint green Wood hint. Bright sunlight and the red of the lantern make her cheeks glow. Expression: gregarious, trusting, content.

people.imagined: Bowing too deeply to a host with a gift held in both hands, whispering a flattering lie.
people.subject: The moment: bowing very low, a gift box in both hands, then glancing up with a sweet smile. Face, most important: a bow a hand's width deeper than needed, the forehead nearly to the box; a smooth, mild, boyish face, soft brown eyes, a slight smile. His eyebrows are soft and straight, his eyes are warm brown, and his smile is slight and sweet. Hair: black, in a neat knot. Body: slim, bowing. He bows from the waist with his back straight and his arms extended, every line polished. Clothing: an undyed hemp robe of fine cloth, a red cord, clean. A tassel of red silk hangs from the box, his sleeves are wide and clean, and his shoes are white-soled. Hands and objects: a lacquered box held in both hands. A second box, wrapped in blue cloth and tied with a neat bow, waits on the floor at his side. Background: a blurred hall door. A long hall with a polished floor, a row of servants waiting, a red screen painted with a bird, and a lamp. Light: soft light from the upper left. A faint red Fire hint. The soft light of the hall shines on the lacquered lid. Expression: humble, deceitful, peaceable.

people.imagined: Before dawn on the stair, tracing the fan-edge scar on her cheek as she lies to a rival.
people.subject: The moment: on a stair before dawn, she touches her scarred cheek with a fingertip while smiling falsely. Face, most important: a thin pale scar down the left cheek from a fan-edge, traced with her finger; a sharp, pretty, narrow face, a pointed chin, bright dark eyes. Her eyebrows are fine and straight, her eyes are black and quick, and her lips are thin. Hair: black, in a high ponytail. Body: lean, quick. She stands with one shoulder forward and her weight on her back foot, ready to move. Clothing: an undyed hemp tunic with a red cord. A red cord ties her hair, her sleeves are rolled and tied, and her sandals have cloth wrapping. Hands and objects: a red fan in the left hand. A towel of grey cloth hangs over her shoulder and a bamboo water flask hangs from her belt. Background: A long stair of red stone in the pale dawn with a few disciples practising in pairs, a banner of plain red, and the dark line of a wall. Light: The pink dawn light picks out the pale line of the scar, from the upper left. A faint red Fire hint. Expression: diligent, ambitious, deceitful.

people.imagined: Pausing under the great wutong and looking up, as she does every time, at the leaves.
people.subject: The moment: standing under a huge tree, face lifted to look up, then glancing back. Face, most important: her face tipped up and eyes on the leaves, a bright dappled light on it; a gentle, pale, round face, a wondering look. Her eyebrows are thin and calm and a few fine freckles dust her nose. Hair: black, in a braid. Body: slight. She stands with her weight even and her neck lengthened as she looks up, an open and unguarded posture. Clothing: an undyed hemp robe with a green cord. A strip of green cloth ties her braid, her sleeves are plain and long, and a small seed charm hangs at her neck. Hands and objects: a basket. Her hands hold an empty reed basket loosely at her hip, and a single dropped leaf has landed on its rim. Background: a blurred huge trunk and leaves. An enormous rough trunk fills the left of the frame with leaves the size of dishes drifting down, a stone path, and a small stone lantern. Light: dappled green-gold light from the upper left. Faint green Wood hint. Gold and green light flickers down through the leaves on to her face. Expression: loyal, cautious, wondering.

people.imagined: The Hall of Virtue at dawn after the flute. She has just laughed at something and the laugh is still on her face; her hand rests on the cloth bag in her sleeve that she has never been seen to open.
people.subject: The moment: in a hall at dawn, she laughs aloud with her head tipped back and then turns her eyes to the viewer, one hand resting in her sleeve. Face, most important: a quick, small, striking face with red-gold colouring, skin the warm gold of a vent bird, hair and eyebrows copper-red; a big laugh showing white teeth, bright amber eyes, comely and sharp. Hair: copper-red, long and swept up into a high crown held by a gold phoenix pin set with five small feathers. Body: small, slight, quick, shoulders squared. Clothing: a vermilion silk robe of the richest cut with a wide crossed collar and long sleeves, over it a cape of tiny feathers in five colours, gold, white, green, black, red; the hem edged with all five bands; a dark red sash. Hands and objects: her left hand rests in her sleeve on a plain cloth bag the size of a fist; in her right hand a closed red feather fan with nine ribs. The five feather colours of the cape lie in careful overlapping rows like roof tiles, and a few red-gold freckles show across her nose. Background: a blurred hall of red pillars and a rose-gold sky. Light: warm gold dawn from the upper left. A faint red-gold Fire hint, not a glow. Expression: arrogant, delighted, sharp.

people.imagined: Barefoot on the hot rock at the lip of the vent, a folded note in his sleeve, looking up as someone climbs towards him.
people.subject: The moment: standing barefoot on hot black rock at the lip of a vent, bent and tall, he looks up with patient honest eyes. Face, most important: white crusted salt-burn scars running up both bare forearms, pale chalk-white against a brown skin, held at his sides; a long, lean, deeply lined face, a heavy brow, a long hooked nose, a short white stubble, tired grey eyes. The soles of his feet and the hands are leathery and cracked, and there is a pale cleft scar on his chin; his eyes have a faint orange reflection from the vent. Hair: grey-white, long, tied in a plain knot with a hemp cord. Body: very tall, stooped at the shoulders, long arms. Clothing: a plain grey hemp vent attendant's robe, darkened with ash and no ornament, short sleeves; bare feet on the rock. Hands and objects: a bronze censer hung from a chain in his right hand, a single ember glowing; his left hand at his sleeve where a folded paper shows. The folded paper in his sleeve is a small square of pale red-ink-stained paper, creased soft with age. Background: a blurred vent with orange glow far below, black rock. Light: orange glow from below and the right, grey above. A strong red Fire hint. Expression: honest, patient, stubborn.

people.imagined: Night in the Hall of Righteousness, a map of the Tower's border spread under one lamp. He has just laid one fan of a pair on the map and put his hand on the pendant of red jade at his collar; the lightning scar down his side shows where his robe has fallen open.
people.subject: The moment: at night beside a lamp, he rests his hand on a red jade pendant at his throat and stares at the viewer with grim, steady grief; his robe has fallen open a hand's width at the left side. Face, most important: a broad, heavy, grey-bearded face, a thick square-cut grey beard to the chest, a broad nose, deep lines from nose to mouth, heavy grey brows over small dark eyes that do not blink; down the left side of his neck, from the ear into the open collar, a branching white-pink lightning scar like a fern frond. Hair: iron grey, thick, tied in a high knot with a red cord and a plain bronze pin. Body: big, broad-chested, thick-necked, solid as a pillar, sitting very upright. Clothing: a vermilion silk robe with a wide crossed collar and a dark-red sash; over it a coat of red-lacquered scale armour, the lacquer over the left breast visibly newer and brighter than the rest; the hem of the robe edged with all five narrow bands. Hands and objects: his left hand holds the red jade pendant, a small carved disc, against his chest; on the map beside him lies one folded red feather fan, its twin missing. Background: a blurred dark hall, a map with brown mountain shapes and no writing, a single lamp. Light: a lamp from the lower left, warm orange, deep shadow behind. A strong red Fire hint. Expression: vengeful, loyal, immovable.

people.imagined: Morning at the Wutong Court. He has just come out to the steps loudly, as he always does, birds on both shoulders, seeds spilling from his pockets, and has spotted a visitor; he booms a greeting while one hand quietly rests on a bark-rough trunk behind him.
people.subject: The moment: standing at the top of a stair, mid-shout, he spreads one arm in a loud greeting while two birds sit on his shoulders. Face, most important: a red-crested bird the size of a pigeon, scarlet crest and green back, perched on his right shoulder, and on his left shoulder a hawk-sized red bird whose long tail feathers end in black char, both close to his face and clear; a big, loud, round, ruddy face, a wide open laughing mouth, thick brown brows, a bulbous nose, bright black eyes, a thick black beard flecked with grey. Hair: black and grey, thick and wild, tied in a topknot with a green cord, a few feathers in it. Body: huge, tall and broad, barrel-chested, a big belly, big hands. Clothing: a long green silk robe, crossed collar, wide sleeves, sewn all over with pressed lacquered brown wutong leaves; streaked white and grey with bird lime on the shoulders; a dark green sash; the hem edged with two narrow bands, gold and green. Hands and objects: a handful of pale seeds spilling from his right fist; more seeds bulge his sleeve pockets; behind him a rough grey trunk. Background: a blurred stair and giant wutong boughs, green light. Light: bright morning light from the upper left, dappled. A faint green Wood and red Fire hint. Expression: gregarious, generous, impatient, a man who cannot be quiet.

people.imagined: The Nest at night, hundreds of fire-silk threads taut in the air like a loom. She stands among them turning a reel of grey thread in one hand and watching the lattice for a thread that has frayed.
people.subject: The moment: standing inside a lattice of taut orange-gold silk threads, she turns a reel of grey thread and looks narrowly at the viewer. Face, most important: burn-calloused fingertips, thick, shiny, brown-pink pads on every finger of the hand that turns the reel, held up near her chin, and a reel of grey thread spinning there; a thin, sharp, hollow-cheeked face, a long nose, thin lips, tight clever dark eyes, deep lines between the brows. Hair: black with grey, scraped into a tight bun pinned with a long iron needle. Body: thin, wiry, upright, shoulders high. Clothing: a robe of very old, faded orange-red silk, restitched along its seams in many slightly different reds as the old silk was reinforced thread by thread, over a vermilion inner robe; a dark red sash; the hem edged with two narrow bands, gold and white; a small wooden thimble ring on each finger. Hands and objects: the grey reel in the right hand; a small array banner with a single orange thread hem on a short pole in the left; a square carved stone seal hanging at the waist. Background: a blurred web of glowing thread-lines in the dark. Light: warm orange glow along the threads and from the lower right. A strong red Fire hint. Expression: diligent, callous, guarded.

people.imagined: In the Hall of Rites, the score archive around her; the funeral drum at her side. She has been tapping out the eighth movement on the table without noticing and has just stopped, as if the missing bar had spoken.
people.subject: The moment: at a table in an archive, her fingers have been tapping a beat and have frozen mid-tap; she looks up with stubborn, patient attention. Face, most important: the fingertips of her right hand flat and wide like a musician's, pads flattened and shiny, caught mid-tap on the wood; a long face, long jaw, long straight nose, high forehead, pale skin, deep-set serious dark eyes, a firm thin mouth. Hair: black, in a severe long knot with a bare black-lacquered pin. Body: tall, thin, straight, long neck. Clothing: an overrobe of black silk embroidered all over with tiny musical marks in red thread, a bare patch at the hem left plain and unstitched; underneath a vermilion silk robe; a dark red sash; the hem edged with two narrow bands, gold and green. Hands and objects: a seven-stringed dark zither on the table with one string visibly broken and curled; a small leather funeral drum at her elbow. Background: a blurred wall of scroll racks, dim. An old pair of wooden sticks for marking the beat and a small bronze chime hang on the wall near a rack of scrolls. Light: a grey light from a window on the upper left. A faint green Wood hint. Expression: patient, devout, stubborn.

people.imagined: At the go board with the head, one stone turning in his fingers; he has just seen that a letter did not reach its reader, and he does not show it, an ink-stained hand lying quiet.
people.subject: The moment: at a go board, he turns a stone slowly between left fingers and looks up with a calm, courteous half smile, giving nothing away. Face, most important: a clearly handsome, soft-featured face, a straight nose, fine brows, large dark gentle eyes, a clean-shaven jaw; ink stains on the side of the right hand lying on the board; a smooth black stone turning between the fingers of his left. Hair: glossy black, in a neat high knot with a red cord and a small gold pin. Body: tall, slender, relaxed and perfectly upright. Clothing: a robe of a single clear vermilion silk, cut like the plumage robe but plain, with a crossed collar, a dark-red sash; the hem edged with a single gold band; at his collar a disc of red jade on a cord. Hands and objects: a black go stone between thumb and finger of the left hand; a wooden go board with scattered stones; a small fan with a short red-feather plume at his elbow. The board shows a half-played game with the white stones ahead; a cup of tea steams untouched at his right and the lamp flame stands perfectly still. Background: a blurred room, a lamp, a screen. Light: soft warm light from the upper left. A faint red Fire hint. Expression: patient, pragmatic, quietly watchful.

people.imagined: 480, the empty ridge: the founder at a hundred and fifty, a wandering flute player come home, sitting under a young wutong with his flute resting on his knee, looking at the bare hill he will fill.
people.subject: The moment: sitting beneath a young tree on a bare ridge with a flute across his knee, he looks into the distance with a gentle, resolved calm. Face, most important: a lean, kindly, travel-lined face, a high forehead, a long straight nose, a thin dark moustache and a short pointed beard, warm patient eyes under level brows, a faint line of a smile. Hair: black, long, tied in a plain knot with a strip of cloth. Body: tall, narrow, easy. He sits cross-legged on a flat stone with his back straight and his shoulders relaxed, a long-limbed wanderer at rest. Clothing: a worn but clean travelling robe of plain grey-brown hemp with a crossed collar and a rope belt, a wanderer's cloak over the shoulders; dusty boots. Hands and objects: a long pale bamboo flute across the knees, held lightly in both hands. At his side lies a bundle of a few belongings in a cloth, a water gourd and a walking staff of plain bamboo. Background: a bare windy ridge and a slender wutong sapling, a pale sky. Light: soft dawn light from the upper left. Painted as an old memorial portrait: faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened, fine cracks. Expression: patient, pragmatic, compassionate.

people.imagined: Dawn, walking the paddies before a council, trousers rolled to the knee, mud to the shin. He has stopped at a dyke to look at the rice and a little of the cloth of his council robe is tucked up in his belt.
people.subject: The moment: standing barefoot at the edge of a flooded paddy at dawn, he looks up from the rice with a mild, kind smile, a council robe tucked up round his waist. Face, most important: a short, sun-browned man, trousers rolled above the knee and mud to the shin, the bare brown legs plain in the frame, and a round, brown, creased face with a wide nose, a thin grey moustache, bright kind small eyes. Hair: grey, in a short knot with a rice-straw cord, a straw hat hung at his back. Body: short, sturdy, thick-legged, solid. Clothing: a vermilion silk robe of a council elder, hitched up and tucked into the sash so the hem does not touch the water; the hem edged with two narrow bands, gold and green; the sleeves rolled. Hands and objects: a young green rice stalk held in one hand; a small wooden rake over his shoulder. A small clay jug of rice wine hangs from his belt by a cord, tucked in beside the folded hem. Background: a blurred paddy glittering with pink dawn water and a line of far hills. Light: low rose-gold dawn light from the upper left. A faint green Wood and ochre Earth hint. Expression: generous, diligent, honest.

people.imagined: At the cinnabar furnace on Chu Sa Tuyền, the spring running hot and red behind her. She has just tasted a pill's powder and her lips are red; the fever flush that never leaves her face is bright, and her eyes are already on the next batch.
people.subject: The moment: at a furnace beside a hot red spring, she touches her tongue to a pinch of red powder and then looks at the viewer sharply. Face, most important: lips stained bright red with cinnabar, a plain scarlet mouth, and a permanent flush of fever on both cheekbones, bright pink-red spots on a pale skin; a sharp-chinned, narrow face, hollow cheeks, a thin straight nose, hot narrow dark eyes. Hair: black, in a tight bun with a long red-lacquer pin; a few strands damp on the brow. Body: thin, sharp-shouldered, tense. Clothing: a vermilion silk robe with the sleeves tied back with cords, a leather apron over it stained red; a dark-red sash; the hem edged with two narrow bands, gold and white; fingers stained. Hands and objects: a small bronze spoon in the right hand with a pinch of red powder on it; on a table a row of little clay pill jars. Her lips are chapped under the red stain, a bead of sweat rolls down her temple, and her ears are pink from the heat. Background: a blurred furnace mouth with orange coals and a pool of steaming red water. Light: orange furnace glow from the right and a pale grey light from the upper left. A strong red Fire hint. Expression: greedy, diligent, hard.

people.imagined: In the Hall of Trust at the end of the day, three keys on a red cord at her collar. A silk broker's daughter, she weighs the viewer the way she would a bolt of silk, and has just decided what they are worth.
people.subject: The moment: seated in a rich hall, she looks at the viewer through heavy lids with the cool appraisal of a merchant, three keys hanging at her breast. Face, most important: three large iron keys of different sizes hanging on a red cord at her chest, bright and clear in the frame; a handsome, heavy-lidded, oval face, a long straight nose, full lips painted a dark rust red, calm dark eyes half closed, smooth olive skin. Hair: black, in an elaborate high coiffure held with gold pins and a comb of red lacquer. Body: full, upright, composed, relaxed. Clothing: a wide-sleeved robe of heavy silk brocade the colour of old embers, a dark rust-orange woven with fine gold thread in small flame shapes; a vermilion inner robe; a dark red sash; the hem edged with two narrow bands, gold and green. Hands and objects: the right hand rests lightly on the keys; the left holds a small ivory abacus. A tray of tea and two small cups stands untouched at her elbow, and a small brass scale rests beside it. Background: a blurred hall with shelves of lacquered boxes. Light: warm lamplight from the upper left, glinting on the gold thread. A faint red Fire and ochre Earth hint. Expression: calm, pragmatic, quietly acquisitive.

people.imagined: On the quay at Thạch Cơ with a ship behind him, mid-laugh; he has come up from a dive and is taking a slow breath, still wet, bare shoulders shining, and hears his own laugh come back off the hull.
people.subject: The moment: on a quay in sun, wet from a dive, he laughs hugely with his head thrown back, drawing a slow, deep breath.
