Face, most important: a huge booming laugh, mouth wide open, strong white teeth; a salt-cracked, brown, weathered face, deep crow's-feet, a broad nose, thick black eyebrows beaded with water, a short salt-and-pepper beard. Hair: black with grey, wet, tied in a short tail. Water drips from his hair on to his shoulders. Body: big-shouldered, deep-chested, thick arms, a diver's barrel chest rising with the slow breath. Clothing: a vermilion silk jacket hanging open and wet, dark with seawater, over a bare chest with a rope cord belt; trousers rolled; the jacket hem edged with two narrow bands, gold and white. Hands and objects: a heavy diver's lead weight on a cord in one fist; in the other a wet coil of rope. Background: a blurred ship's hull with a red pennant and a bright sea. A neat row of coiled hawsers and a stack of barrels line the quay, and two sailors point out to sea. Light: strong sun from the upper left, glittering on the water drops. A faint red Fire and blue Water hint. Expression: gregarious, stubborn, delighted.

people.imagined: On the wall of the vein fort at dusk, in armour whose seams are red with cinnabar dust. She has come out to look at the pass and is turning back; the thunder-burn along her jaw has caught the last light.
people.subject: The moment: on a fort wall at dusk in armour, she turns her head to look square at the viewer, jaw set. Face, most important: a pale, shiny thunder burn spread like a small fern along the line of her jaw from ear to chin, standing out against a weathered skin, and red cinnabar dust in every seam of her armour at the collar; a square, hard face, a short broad nose, thick black brows, level dark eyes. Hair: black, cropped short, a few grey hairs, bound with a red band. Body: stocky, square-shouldered, planted, large red-brown hands. Clothing: a suit of red-lacquered scale armour, the scales edged in dust-red, over a vermilion robe; a dark red sash; the hem edged with two narrow bands, gold and white; a leather gauntlet on one hand, the other bare and red. Hands and objects: a pair of closed red fans, one at her belt, one held low in her right hand. A small bronze watch-horn hangs at her hip beside a rolled map-case, and a hawk-feather is stuck in her helmet strap. Background: a blurred stone parapet and a violet pass far below. Light: low red dusk light from the upper left. A strong red Fire hint. Expression: brave, just, unforgiving.

people.imagined: Late evening in his guest room, back against the wall as always; a small clay figure half-shaped in his hands, a shelf of them behind him all facing a window.
people.subject: The moment: seated with his back to a wall, he shapes a small clay figure in his hands and looks up at the viewer with a calm, reserved gaze. Face, most important: a plain pale-grey guest's robe open at the collar over a collar of Tower blue at his throat, a vivid deep blue band showing under it; a narrow, grey-skinned, long face, grey eyes, a long thin nose, thin lips, a grey stubble, deep lines. Hair: grey, short, combed flat. A thin streak of white runs from the left temple. Body: thin, narrow-shouldered, sitting very straight against the wall. Clothing: a plain pale-grey guest's robe with a crossed collar and a sash of undyed hemp, the inner robe collar blue; no hem bands. Hands and objects: a half-formed grey clay figure the size of a finger in his hands; behind him on a shelf a long row of identical tiny clay figures, all facing a window. On the table before him lies a straight sword in a plain blue scabbard, a cloth beside it for cleaning. Background: a blurred shelf and a dark window. Light: a lamp from the upper left, grey-gold. A faint blue-grey Metal and Water hint, with a thread of Fire. Expression: calm, loyal, reclusive.

people.imagined: On the Fire Court stair at dawn with a closed fan pointing at a pupil's wrist: 'there'. Her sleeves are burnt to the elbow and she barks the correction.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a stair, she points a closed red fan sharply at the viewer's wrist like a teacher's rod, correcting them. Face, most important: both sleeves scorched black to the elbow, bare forearms thick with burn freckles, dark pink dots in hundreds, held out in front; a lean, bony face, burn-freckled across the nose and cheeks, a sharp chin, bright impatient hazel eyes, a thin mouth. Her lashes are singed short and she has a small burn mark by her left ear. Hair: red-brown, in a high plait pinned up. Fine strands escape the plait and curl at her temples. Body: lean, wiry, forward-leaning, quick. Clothing: a vermilion silk robe with the sleeves burned off short at the elbow, the scorched edge trimmed clean, a dark red sash, leather bracers; the hem edged with two narrow bands, gold and white. Hands and objects: a closed red feather fan used as a pointer in the right hand. A string of small bronze rings, each marking a pupil's passed test, hangs from her sash. Background: a blurred red stone stair, with a row of young disciples. Light: bright morning light from the upper left. A strong red Fire hint. Expression: impatient, brave, exacting.

people.imagined: In his rooms at the music market at night, an old score unrolled before him, ink on his cuffs; he smiles tidily as someone comes in, and slides a cipher page under the score.
people.subject: The moment: at a desk, he smiles tidily at the viewer while one hand slides a page under an old scroll. Face, most important: ink-stained cuffs on both sleeves, black to the wrist, in front, and a smooth, calm, smiling, tidy face, a neat thin moustache, mild, clever, dark eyes; a polite curve to the mouth. His eyelids are heavy and his smile is accompanied by tiny creases at the corners of the eyes. Hair: black, parted and oiled, in a neat knot with a plain pin. Body: slim, tidy, upright. He sits with his back straight and his hands folded on the desk, an air of calm tidiness. Clothing: a vermilion robe of fine cloth, crisp and clean, a crossed collar, a dark red sash, the cuffs black with ink; the hem edged with two narrow bands, gold and green. Hands and objects: an old yellowed score scroll unrolled with small notes in dots; a bamboo flute on the desk, unplayed. Background: a blurred shelf of old scrolls. Beyond the desk a window shows the lamp-lit lane of the market and a scrap of paper lantern. Light: a lamp from the upper left. A faint green Wood hint. Expression: deceitful, calm, ambitious.

people.imagined: The winter after Hỏa Ti Trấn burned: the first disciple standing at a roadside with her fan lowered, her face lit from below by the fire she carries inside her.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a field of ash at dusk, she lowers a fan and gazes at the viewer with a fierce, just, tired look. Face, most important: a strong, angular, broad-browed face, high cheekbones, a straight, proud nose, a firm wide mouth, deep-set dark eyes lit orange from below as if by a fire, a hint of fire-ash at the eyelids. Her cheeks are streaked with ash and a thin scar crosses her upper lip. Hair: black, long and loose, whipping to one side. Body: tall, strong, broad-shouldered, upright. She holds herself rigid, shoulders square, as though bearing a great weight. Clothing: a long vermilion robe with wide sleeves, scorched black at the cuffs, a dark red sash, a short red-lacquered breastplate. Hands and objects: a large red feather fan, nine ribs, held lowered in her right hand, its edge charred. Background: a blurred dark field of ash and a red sky. Small figures walk away along a road in the distance, and a burned building frame stands to one side. Light: orange firelight from below and the left. Painted as an old memorial portrait: faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened, fine cracks. Expression: wrathful, brave, just.

people.imagined: 760, with the zither on her lap, trying the eighth string. Her hand has gone still on it; she is listening to a note that has not come yet.
people.subject: The moment: seated before a zither, a hand on the eighth string, she listens with eyes half closed to a note that does not come. Face, most important: a long, serene, devout, pale face, a high forehead, a long straight nose, closed, thoughtful lids, a stubborn little set to the mouth; her hair is bound in a high knot. A faint line of fatigue shadows each eye and her lips are lightly pressed. Hair: black, in a high knot with a plain jade pin. Body: slim, upright, seated with a straight back. Clothing: a long robe of grey-white silk with wide sleeves and a pale-green sash. A string of small jade chimes hangs from her belt, and a silk ribbon ties her sleeves. Hands and objects: a long dark zither on her lap with eight silk strings, the last one snapped and curling; her left hand pressing, her right poised. Background: a blurred hall wall and a pale window. A bamboo screen and a vase with a single white flower stand beside her. Light: soft light from the upper left. Painted as an old memorial portrait: faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened, fine cracks. Expression: devout, patient, stubborn.

people.imagined: The siege line at Cô Thành, 722: the general standing before the walls, hand lifting to give the order for the fire, chin high.
people.subject: The moment: standing before a fortress wall at dusk, he lifts one hand to give an order, chin raised, proud. Face, most important: a hard, handsome, wide-jawed face, a thick red-brown beard trimmed square, a hooked nose, flaring nostrils, fierce black eyes under heavy brows, a high, arrogant forehead. Hair: red-brown, tied in a high knot under a plain iron cap. A few long strands of red-brown hair blow across his cheek. Body: tall, broad, heavy-shouldered, a soldier. He stands with his legs braced and his chest out, a commander at ease with command. Clothing: a red-lacquered scale cuirass over a vermilion robe, a dark red cloak thrown back, a broad belt. Hands and objects: a closed red war fan in his left hand; his right hand held up, palm out. A short iron baton hangs from his belt and a map case is slung across his back. Background: A line of siege towers and a column of black smoke climb behind him, and a few banners of plain red show above the wall. Light: red dusk light from the left. Painted as an old memorial portrait: faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened, fine cracks. Expression: wrathful, loyal, arrogant.

people.imagined: 1042, the ninth day at Thủ Lôi Bảo: the master of the Hall of Righteousness stands in the gate of the burning fort, fan up, impatient to finish, as lightning gathers in the walls behind him.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a burning gate, fan raised, glancing over his shoulder with a fierce, impatient look. Face, most important: a lean, strong, sun-dark face, a short black beard, a straight nose, glittering eager black eyes, a wide mouth open as if shouting an order, a streak of soot across one cheek. A trickle of sweat runs down his cheek through the soot. Hair: black, in a high knot with a red cord, strands loose and singed. A few strands of grey are at his temples. Body: tall, wiry, taut, leaning forward. Clothing: a vermilion silk robe with a crossed collar and wide sleeves, scorched at the hem, a red-lacquered breastplate, a dark red sash. A narrow band of red silk is tied round his upper arm and his boots are blackened. Hands and objects: a red feather fan lifted in his right hand, fanning an orange flame; a faint blue-white crackle at the stone wall behind him. Sparks drift through the air around him like fireflies, and the red silk of his sleeve has a bright scorched streak at the cuff. Background: a blurred burning gate and red smoke. Light: orange firelight from the lower right. Painted as an old memorial portrait: faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened, fine cracks. Expression: brave, impatient, warlike.

people.imagined: The vein fort, 1154, on the pass in the early morning: a calm woman with a fan in one hand and a daughter's small hand in the other, looking out over the cinnabar vein before the day's work.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a ridge at early morning, she looks calmly at the viewer with a gentle, just expression, a red fan in her right hand. Face, most important: a broad, calm, gentle face, wide-set grey-brown eyes, a firm jaw, soft full lips, a faint line between the brows; at her collar a small red jade pendant. Hair: black, in a low coil with a worn red-lacquered wooden hairpin carved with a small flame. A few grey hairs shine in the coil. Body: tall, broad-shouldered, upright. She stands with her feet apart and her shoulders level, a calm unhurried bearing. Clothing: a vermilion silk robe with a crossed collar, a dark red sash, a red-lacquered breastplate; the hem edged with two narrow bands, gold and white. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a closed red feather fan, its twin missing; the left hand rests at her side. Background: a blurred red-brown ridge and a pale morning sky. A line of small tents and a fort wall appear on the ridge behind her, and a few red banners flutter. Light: soft light from the upper left. Painted as an old memorial portrait: faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened, fine cracks. Expression: calm, just, compassionate.

people.imagined: 592, dawn at the burned town: a reeler's girl in a shed's doorway, ash on her hands, hanks of unburned silk held to her chest, offering them.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a charred shed doorway at dawn, she clutches hanks of orange silk to her chest and holds them out, offering. Face, most important: a young, thin, soot-streaked face, a straight small nose, large dark forgiving eyes, a trembling humble mouth, tear tracks through the ash on her cheeks. Her eyelashes are singed short. Hair: black, in a plain braid, singed ends. Body: thin, narrow-shouldered, young. She stands with her shoulders hunched and her feet bare in the ashes, small and slight. Clothing: a plain brown hemp reeler's jacket and skirt, scorched at the hem, an apron blackened with ash. The apron has a large patch of unburnt cloth sewn at the front, and a cord of yellow silk is tied round her wrist. Hands and objects: hanks of glowing orange-gold fire-silk held in both hands, bright against the black. A broken reeling frame leans against the doorpost beside her and a basket of blackened cocoons lies at her feet. Background: a blurred burnt shed and a smoky pink dawn. Light: pale dawn from the upper left, a little orange glow from the silk. Painted as an old memorial portrait: faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened, fine cracks. Expression: diligent, forgiving, humble.
